135	# ------------------------------------------------------------ feature lines
136	def feature_lines(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], door_count: int = 4) -> List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]]:
137	    V = mesh.vertices
138	    lines: List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
139	    D, E, F, Gj, H = J["D"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["H"]
140	    st = station_index
141	    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
142	
143	    def chain(j, i0, i1):
144	        return np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
145	
146	    def ring_seg(i, j0, j1):
147	        r = ring_pts(mesh, i)
148	        idx = list(range(j0, j1 + 1)) if j1 >= j0 else list(range(j0, j1 - 1, -1))
149	        return r[idx]
150	
151	    for side, mir in (("L", lambda j: j), ("R", mirror_index)):
152	        # hood: side seams along the fender/hood edge, rear seam across the cowl
153	        lines.append((f"hood_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), st("cowl") + 1, st("front") - 3)))
154	        # trunk lid side seams
155	        lines.append((f"deck_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), 3, st("deck"))))
156	        # B pillar seams sill -> roof rail
157	        for nm in ("bp_r", "bp_f"):
158	            lines.append((f"{nm}_seam_{side}", ring_seg(st(nm), mir(D), mir(Gj))))
159	        # front door leading edge: vertical on the door, then along the A pillar aperture edge
160	        x_fd = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
161	        vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_fd, mir(D), mir(E))
162	        pil = ring_seg(st("roof_front"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
163	        lines.append((f"front_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
164	        if door_count >= 4:
165	            x_rd = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
166	            vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_rd, mir(D), mir(E))
167	            pil = ring_seg(st("cp_f"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
168	            lines.append((f"rear_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
169	    # transverse seams (over the top)
170	    lines.append(("hood_rear_seam", ring_seg(st("cowl") + 1, F, mirror_index(F))))
171	    lines.append(("deck_front_seam", ring_seg(st("deck"), F, mirror_index(F))))
172	    # nose & tail hood/trunk front edges
173	    lines.append(("hood_front_seam", ring_seg(st("front") - 3, F, mirror_index(F))))
174	    return lines

177	# --------------------------------------------------------------- connectors
178	def emit_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
179	    """All connectors the body emits.  `hints` carries non-geometric options:
180	    door_count, seat_rows ('auto'|int), drive ('left'|'right'), fuel_side."""
181	    V = mesh.vertices
182	    out: List[Connector] = []
183	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
184	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
185	    ysign_driver = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
186	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
187	
188	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- wheels
189	    tire_w = float(hints.get("tire_width", 0.225))
190	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
191	        cx, cz, r = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], meas[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], meas[f"arch_{tag}_r"]
192	        tire_r = r - float(hints.get("arch_gap", 0.06))
193	        y = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] - tire_w / 2 - 0.01
194	        for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
195	            fr = Frame.from_normal([cx, ys * y, cz], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X)
196	            out.append(CircleConnector(f"wheel_{tag}_{side}", fr, tire_r, tags=["wheel", f"wheel_{tag}"],
197	                                       meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "axle": tag,
198	                                             "tire_width": tire_w, "arch_radius": r, "steer": tag == "front"}))
199	
200	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- apertures
201	    for name in mesh.meta["aperture_rects"]:
202	        pts, grid, nrm, grid_pts = aperture_loop(mesh, name)
203	        short = name.split("/", 1)[1]
204	        kind = "glass" if short.startswith(("glass", "windshield", "rear_window")) else "light"
205	        tags = [kind, short.rstrip("_LR").rstrip("_")]
206	        if short.startswith("headlight"):
207	            tags.append("headlight")
208	        if short.startswith("taillight"):
209	            tags.append("taillight")
210	        side = "left" if short.endswith("_L") else "right" if short.endswith("_R") else "center"
211	        x_hint = Y if kind == "glass" else X
212	        conn = PolygonConnector.from_points(name.replace("aperture/", ""), pts, normal_hint=nrm, x_hint=x_hint,
213	                                            tags=tags, meta={"grid": list(grid), "grid_points": grid_pts, "side": side, "aperture": True})
214	        out.append(conn)
215	
216	    # --------------------------------------------------------- exterior bits
217	    nose = V[mesh.groups["nose_ring"]]
218	    tail = V[mesh.groups["tail_ring"]]
219	    apex_f = V[mesh.groups["apex_front"]][0]
220	    apex_r = V[mesh.groups["apex_rear"]][0]
221	    nose_n = _face_normal_from_ring(nose, +1)
222	    tail_n = _face_normal_from_ring(tail, -1)
223	    z_nose_top, z_nose_bot = meas["nose_z_top"], meas["nose_z_bottom"]
224	    z_tail_top, z_tail_bot = meas["tail_z_top"], meas["tail_z_bottom"]
225	    nose_w = 2 * meas["nose_top_half_width"]
226	    tail_w = 2 * meas["tail_top_half_width"]
227	
228	    def on_face(apex, nrm, z, ahead=0.004):
229	        # point on the fascia plane at height z (shifted along the normal a bit)
230	        p = np.array([apex[0], 0.0, z])
231	        # move onto the (raked) face: plane through apex with normal nrm
232	        d = np.dot(apex - p, nrm) / max(abs(nrm[0]), 1e-6)
233	        p[0] += d * np.sign(nrm[0])
234	        return p + nrm * ahead
235	
236	    grille_z = z_nose_top - 0.18
237	    out.append(RectangleConnector("grille", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
238	                                  min(nose_w * 0.62, 1.1), 0.17, tags=["grille"], meta={"style_hint": hints.get("style", "sedan")}))
239	    intake_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16
240	    out.append(RectangleConnector("intake", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, intake_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
241	                                  min(nose_w * 0.8, 1.2), 0.14, tags=["grille", "intake"], meta={"lower": True}))
242	    plate_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16 + 0.15
243	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, (grille_z + intake_z) / 2 - 0.02, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
244	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "front"}))
245	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.5 * (z_tail_top - z_tail_bot), 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y),
246	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
247	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z + 0.11, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y), tags=["badge"]))
248	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_top - 0.16, 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y), tags=["badge"]))
249	    # exhaust tips
250	    for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
251	        p = on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.10, 0.0)
252	        p[1] = ys * (meas["tail_half_width"] - 0.32)
253	        out.append(CircleConnector(f"exhaust_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, tail_n, x_hint=Y), 0.038, tags=["exhaust"],
254	                                   meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
255	    # side mirrors at the front-bottom corner of the front door glass
256	    st = station_index
257	    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
258	        p = V[vidx(mesh, st("roof_front"), mir(J["F"]))].copy()
259	        p[0] += 0.02
260	        p[2] += 0.02
261	        out.append(PointConnector(f"mirror_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, [0.0, ys, 0.0], x_hint=X), tags=["mirror"],
262	                                  meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
263	        # door handles: on the door skin just below the belt, mid-door
264	        x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
265	        x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
266	        for door, x0, x1, ok in (("front", x_fd0, x_fd1, True),
267	                                 ("rear", x_fd1, meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02, door_count >= 4)):
268	            if not ok:
269	                continue
270	            xh = x1 + 0.62 * (x0 - x1)
271	            zh = meas["z_belt"] - 0.11
272	            line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xh, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
273	            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zh)))
274	            p = line[k].copy()
275	            nrm = np.array([0.0, ys, 0.0])
276	            out.append(PointConnector(f"handle_{door}_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, nrm, x_hint=X), tags=["handle"],
277	                                      meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door}))
278	        # roof rails along the roof edge (upper chain is numbered rear -> front)
279	        i0, i1 = st("roof_rear") + 1, st("roof_front") - 1
280	        if i1 > i0 + 1:
281	            pts = np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, mir(J["G"]))] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
282	            length = float(pts[-1, 0] - pts[0, 0])
283	            c = pts.mean(axis=0)
284	            fr = Frame.from_normal(c, Z, x_hint=X)
285	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"roof_rail_{side}", fr, abs(length), 0.05, tags=["roof_rail"],
286	                                          meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "path": pts}))
287	    # fuel cap on the rear quarter (fuel side from hints)
288	    fs = hints.get("fuel_side", "left")
289	    ys = 1.0 if fs == "left" else -1.0
290	    mir = (lambda j: j) if ys > 0 else mirror_index
291	    xf = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + 0.08
292	    line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xf, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
293	    zf = meas["z_belt"] - 0.20
294	    k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zf)))
295	    out.append(CircleConnector("fuel_cap", Frame.from_normal(line[k], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X), 0.065, tags=["fuel_cap"],
296	                               meta={"side": fs}))
297	    # antenna / shark fin near the rear of the roof
298	    i_ant = st("roof_rear") + 1
299	    p = V[vidx(mesh, i_ant, J["H"])]
300	    out.append(PointConnector("antenna", Frame.from_normal(p, Z, x_hint=X), tags=["antenna"]))
301	
302	    # -------------------------------------------------------------- interior
303	    out += interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
304	    from .connectors_extra import extra_exterior_connectors
305	    out += extra_exterior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
306	    return out

309	def _face_normal_from_ring(ring: np.ndarray, sign: float) -> np.ndarray:
310	    top = ring[J["H"]]
311	    bot = ring[J["A"]]
312	    d = top - bot  # face direction (mostly vertical, tilted by the rake)
313	    n = np.array([d[2], 0.0, -d[0]])
314	    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
315	    if np.sign(n[0]) != np.sign(sign):
316	        n = -n
317	    return n

320	def interior_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
321	    V = mesh.vertices
322	    out: List[Connector] = []
323	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
324	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
325	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
326	    ysd = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
327	    st = station_index
328	
329	    floor = meas["z_floor"] + 0.05             # cabin floor (carpet top)
330	    inner_half = meas["y_shoulder"] - 0.08     # cabin inner half width at the belt
331	    roof_h = meas["z_roof_front"]
332	    h_point = float(hints.get("h_point_height", np.clip(0.17 + (roof_h - 1.2) * 0.4, 0.17, 0.38)))
333	    x_h1 = meas["x_cowl"] - float(hints.get("front_h_point_offset", 0.95))
334	    z_h1 = floor + h_point
335	    y_seat = min(0.42, inner_half - 0.36)
336	    x_firewall = meas["x_cowl"] + 0.12
337	    has_bed = meas.get("has_bed", 0.0) > 0.5
338	    x_cab_rear = min(meas["x_roof_rear"] - 0.05, meas["x_deck"] + 0.55) if not has_bed else meas["x_deck"] - 0.05
339	    x_cab_rear = min(x_cab_rear, meas["x_roof_rear"] + 0.15)
340	    # seat rows -----------------------------------------------------------------
341	    rows_cfg = hints.get("seat_rows", "auto")
342	    pitch = 0.86
343	    row_x = [x_h1]
344	    while len(row_x) < 3 and row_x[-1] - pitch - 0.30 > x_cab_rear - 0.12:
345	        row_x.append(row_x[-1] - pitch)
346	    if rows_cfg != "auto":
347	        rows_cfg = int(rows_cfg)
348	        row_x = [x_h1 - k * pitch for k in range(max(1, rows_cfg))]
349	    n_rows = len(row_x)
350	    seat_w, seat_d = 0.52, 0.55
351	    for r, xh in enumerate(row_x):
352	        if r == 0:
353	            for name, ys in (("driver", ysd), ("passenger", -ysd)):
354	                fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.12, ys * y_seat, floor], Z, x_hint=X)
355	                out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_front_{name}", fr, seat_d, seat_w, tags=["seat", "seat_front"],
356	                                              meta={"row": 0, "role": name, "h_point_height": h_point,
357	                                                    "headroom": roof_h - 0.03 - floor, "side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
358	        else:
359	            bench_w = 2 * inner_half - 0.12
360	            room = row_x[r - 1] - xh
361	            fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.10, 0.0, floor + (0.02 if r == 1 else 0.0)], Z, x_hint=X)
362	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_row{r + 1}", fr, seat_d - 0.05, bench_w, tags=["seat", "seat_bench", f"seat_row{r + 1}"],
363	                                          meta={"row": r, "role": "bench", "h_point_height": h_point - 0.02 * r,
364	                                                "headroom": meas["z_roof_rear"] - 0.03 - floor if r == n_rows - 1 else roof_h - floor,
365	                                                "legroom": room}))
366	    # steering wheel / column ---------------------------------------------------
367	    col_angle = np.radians(float(hints.get("column_angle", 24.0)))
368	    wheel_c = np.array([x_h1 + 0.52, ysd * y_seat, z_h1 + 0.32])
369	    n = np.array([-np.cos(col_angle), 0.0, np.sin(col_angle)])
370	    out.append(CircleConnector("steering_wheel", Frame.from_normal(wheel_c, n, x_hint=Y), 0.185, tags=["steering_wheel"],
371	                               meta={"column_angle_deg": float(np.degrees(col_angle)), "column_length": 0.35}))
372	    # dashboard: interior section just behind the windshield base ----------------
373	    cowl = ring_pts(mesh, st("cowl"))
374	    yE = cowl[J["E"], 1] - 0.09
375	    z_top = meas["z_cowl"] - 0.03
376	    z_lo = floor + 0.32
377	    x_dash = meas["x_cowl"] - 0.02
378	    dash_pts = np.array([
379	        [x_dash, -yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_top - 0.12], [x_dash, yE - 0.10, z_top],
380	        [x_dash, -yE + 0.10, z_top], [x_dash, -yE, z_top - 0.12],
381	    ])
382	    dash = PolygonConnector.from_points("dashboard", dash_pts, normal_hint=-X, x_hint=-Y, tags=["dashboard"],
383	                                        meta={"driver_y": ysd * y_seat, "depth": 0.55, "floor": floor,
384	                                              "windshield_x": meas["x_cowl"], "steering_center": wheel_c})
385	    out.append(dash)
386	    # pedals ------------------------------------------------------------------------
387	    out.append(RectangleConnector("pedals", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.86, ysd * y_seat, floor + 0.02], Z, x_hint=X),
388	                                  0.20, 0.34, tags=["pedals"], meta={"transmission": hints.get("transmission", "automatic")}))
389	    # centre console between the front seats --------------------------------------
390	    console_len = 0.95
391	    out.append(RectangleConnector("console", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.18, 0.0, floor], Z, x_hint=X), console_len, 0.26,
392	                                  tags=["console"], meta={"height": z_h1 - floor + 0.06, "driver_y": ysd * y_seat}))
393	    # cabin floor --------------------------------------------------------------------
394	    fl_len = x_firewall - x_cab_rear
395	    out.append(RectangleConnector("floor", Frame.from_normal([(x_firewall + x_cab_rear) / 2, 0.0, floor - 0.01], Z, x_hint=X),
396	                                  fl_len, 2 * inner_half + 0.10, tags=["floor"], meta={"tunnel_height": 0.16, "seat_rows": n_rows}))
397	    # firewall / bulkheads (simple rectangles so the cabin reads as enclosed)
398	    out.append(RectangleConnector("firewall", Frame.from_normal([x_firewall, 0.0, (floor + z_lo) / 2], -X, x_hint=-Y),
399	                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, z_lo - floor + 0.02, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "front"}))
400	    out.append(RectangleConnector("rear_bulkhead", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear, 0.0, (floor + meas["z_belt"]) / 2], X, x_hint=Y),
401	                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, meas["z_belt"] - floor, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
402	    # parcel shelf (sedan) or cargo floor (hatch/wagon)
403	    if meas["x_deck"] < x_cab_rear - 0.2 and not has_bed:
404	        length = x_cab_rear - meas["x_deck"]
405	        out.append(RectangleConnector("parcel_shelf", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - length / 2, 0.0, meas["z_deck"] - 0.10], Z, x_hint=X),

"""Derive measurements, feature lines (seams) and connectors from a morphed body.

Everything here reads *vertex groups* and the aperture grid recorded by the
generator, never the generator parameters, so connectors follow the mesh
wherever the targets move it (the MakeHuman "joints follow the mesh" idea).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import numpy as np

from ..geometry.mesh import Mesh
from ..geometry.frame import Frame
from ..connectors import Connector, PointConnector, PolygonConnector, RectangleConnector, CircleConnector
from .generator import RING, RING_N, HALF_N, N_STATIONS, mirror_index, station_index

J = RING  # shorthand: J["F"] etc.


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def vidx(mesh: Mesh, station: int, j: int) -> int:
    return (station + mesh.meta["ring_offset"]) * RING_N + j


def ring_pts(mesh: Mesh, station: int) -> np.ndarray:
    a = vidx(mesh, station, 0)
    return mesh.vertices[a : a + RING_N]


def fit_circle(pts_xz: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
    """Algebraic least-squares circle fit in 2-D -> (cx, cz, r)."""
    x, y = pts_xz[:, 0], pts_xz[:, 1]
    A = np.column_stack([x, y, np.ones_like(x)])
    b = x * x + y * y
    sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
    cx, cy = sol[0] / 2, sol[1] / 2
    r = np.sqrt(max(sol[2] + cx * cx + cy * cy, 1e-9))
    return float(cx), float(cy), float(r)


def surface_line_at_x(mesh: Mesh, x_target: float, j_from: int, j_to: int, stations=None) -> np.ndarray:
    """Polyline on the loft surface at constant x, for ring indices j_from..j_to.
    Each ring index j is a longitudinal vertex chain; we interpolate along it."""
    stations = range(N_STATIONS) if stations is None else stations
    out = []
    step = 1 if j_to >= j_from else -1
    for j in range(j_from, j_to + step, step):
        chain = np.array([mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in stations])
        xs = chain[:, 0]
        k = np.clip(np.searchsorted(xs, x_target) - 1, 0, len(xs) - 2)
        t = np.clip((x_target - xs[k]) / max(xs[k + 1] - xs[k], 1e-9), 0, 1)
        out.append(chain[k] + (chain[k + 1] - chain[k]) * t)
    return np.asarray(out)


def aperture_loop(mesh: Mesh, name: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Tuple[int, int], np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Ordered vertex loop around a grid aperture + (rows, cols) + outward normal
    + the full vertex grid (rows, cols, 3) the aperture was cut from."""
    r0, r1, j0, j1 = mesh.meta["aperture_rects"][name]
    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
    # rows are loft ring rows (already include the fascia offset); convert to station space
    r0s, r1s = r0 - off, r1 - off + 1
    j1e = j1 + 1
    loop = []
    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j0) for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, r1s, j) for j in range(j0 + 1, j1e + 1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j1e) for r in range(r1s - 1, r0s - 1, -1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, r0s, j) for j in range(j1e - 1, j0, -1)]
    pts = mesh.vertices[loop]
    grid = np.array([[mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, r, j)] for j in range(j0, j1e + 1)] for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)])
    faces = mesh.zones[name]
    if "_face_normals" not in mesh.meta:
        mesh.meta["_face_normals"] = mesh.face_normals()
    fn = mesh.meta["_face_normals"][faces].mean(axis=0)
    fn /= max(np.linalg.norm(fn), 1e-9)
    return pts, (r1s - r0s + 1, j1e - j0 + 1), fn, grid


# ------------------------------------------------------------ measurements
def measure(mesh: Mesh) -> Dict[str, float]:
    V = mesh.vertices
    G = mesh.groups

    def ring(name):
        return V[G[f"ring/{name}"]]

    def lring(name):
        return V[G[f"lring/{name}"]]

    H, E, F, Gj, D, A = J["H"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["D"], J["A"]
    cowl, rf, rr, deck = ring("cowl"), ring("roof_front"), ring("roof_rear"), ring("deck")
    bp = ring("bp_r")
    m: Dict[str, float] = {}
    m["x_front"] = float(V[G["apex_front"]][0, 0])
    m["x_rear"] = float(V[G["apex_rear"]][0, 0])
    m["length"] = m["x_front"] - m["x_rear"]
    m["width"] = float(2 * np.abs(V[:, 1]).max())
    m["height"] = float(V[:, 2].max())
    m["x_cowl"], m["z_cowl"] = float(cowl[H, 0]), float(cowl[H, 2])
    m["x_roof_front"], m["z_roof_front"] = float(rf[H, 0]), float(rf[H, 2])
    m["x_roof_rear"], m["z_roof_rear"] = float(rr[H, 0]), float(rr[H, 2])
    m["x_deck"], m["z_deck"] = float(deck[H, 0]), float(deck[H, 2])
    m["x_bpillar"] = float(0.5 * (ring("bp_r")[Gj, 0] + ring("bp_f")[Gj, 0]))
    m["roof_half_width"] = float(0.5 * (rf[Gj, 1] + rr[Gj, 1]))
    # cabin section at the B pillar
    m["z_belt"] = float(bp[E, 2])
    m["y_belt"] = float(bp[E, 1])
    m["y_shoulder"] = float(bp[F, 1])
    m["z_sill"] = float(np.mean([lring("ra_end")[D, 2], lring("fa_start")[D, 2]]))
    m["y_sill"] = float(lring("fa_start")[D, 1])
    cabin_st = range(station_index("bp_r") - 4, station_index("bp_f") + 4)
    m["z_floor"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, A), 2] for i in cabin_st]))
    m["y_floor_edge"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, J["B"]), 1] for i in cabin_st]))
    # wheels
    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
        pts = V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, [0, 2]]
        cx, cz, r = fit_circle(pts)
        m[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], m[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], m[f"arch_{tag}_r"] = cx, cz, r
        m[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] = float(np.mean(V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, 1]))
    m["wheelbase"] = m["wheel_front_x"] - m["wheel_rear_x"]
    m["track"] = 2 * m["wheel_front_y"]
    # nose / tail faces
    nose, tail = V[G["nose_ring"]], V[G["tail_ring"]]
    m["nose_z_top"], m["nose_z_bottom"] = float(nose[H, 2]), float(nose[A, 2])
    m["nose_half_width"] = float(nose[E, 1])
    m["nose_top_half_width"] = float(nose[Gj, 1])
    m["tail_z_top"], m["tail_z_bottom"] = float(tail[H, 2]), float(tail[A, 2])
    m["tail_half_width"] = float(tail[E, 1])
    m["tail_top_half_width"] = float(tail[Gj, 1])
    m["bed"] = float(max(0.0, V[G["ring/deck"]][H, 2] - V[vidx(mesh, station_index("deck") // 2, H), 2]))
    m["has_bed"] = float(m["bed"] > 0.2)
    return m


# ------------------------------------------------------------ feature lines
def feature_lines(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], door_count: int = 4) -> List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]]:
    V = mesh.vertices
    lines: List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
    D, E, F, Gj, H = J["D"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["H"]
    st = station_index
    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]

    def chain(j, i0, i1):
        return np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])

    def ring_seg(i, j0, j1):
        r = ring_pts(mesh, i)
        idx = list(range(j0, j1 + 1)) if j1 >= j0 else list(range(j0, j1 - 1, -1))
        return r[idx]

    for side, mir in (("L", lambda j: j), ("R", mirror_index)):
        # hood: side seams along the fender/hood edge, rear seam across the cowl
        lines.append((f"hood_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), st("cowl") + 1, st("front") - 3)))
        # trunk lid side seams
        lines.append((f"deck_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), 3, st("deck"))))
        # B pillar seams sill -> roof rail
        for nm in ("bp_r", "bp_f"):
            lines.append((f"{nm}_seam_{side}", ring_seg(st(nm), mir(D), mir(Gj))))
        # front door leading edge: vertical on the door, then along the A pillar aperture edge
        x_fd = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
        vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_fd, mir(D), mir(E))
        pil = ring_seg(st("roof_front"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
        lines.append((f"front_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
        if door_count >= 4:
            x_rd = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
            vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_rd, mir(D), mir(E))
            pil = ring_seg(st("cp_f"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
            lines.append((f"rear_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
    # transverse seams (over the top)
    lines.append(("hood_rear_seam", ring_seg(st("cowl") + 1, F, mirror_index(F))))
    lines.append(("deck_front_seam", ring_seg(st("deck"), F, mirror_index(F))))
    # nose & tail hood/trunk front edges
    lines.append(("hood_front_seam", ring_seg(st("front") - 3, F, mirror_index(F))))
    return lines


# --------------------------------------------------------------- connectors
def emit_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
    """All connectors the body emits.  `hints` carries non-geometric options:
    door_count, seat_rows ('auto'|int), drive ('left'|'right'), fuel_side."""
    V = mesh.vertices
    out: List[Connector] = []
    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
    ysign_driver = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- wheels
    tire_w = float(hints.get("tire_width", 0.225))
    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
        cx, cz, r = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], meas[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], meas[f"arch_{tag}_r"]
        tire_r = r - float(hints.get("arch_gap", 0.06))
        y = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] - tire_w / 2 - 0.01
        for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
            fr = Frame.from_normal([cx, ys * y, cz], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X)
            out.append(CircleConnector(f"wheel_{tag}_{side}", fr, tire_r, tags=["wheel", f"wheel_{tag}"],
                                       meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "axle": tag,
                                             "tire_width": tire_w, "arch_radius": r, "steer": tag == "front"}))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- apertures
    for name in mesh.meta["aperture_rects"]:
        pts, grid, nrm, grid_pts = aperture_loop(mesh, name)
        short = name.split("/", 1)[1]
        kind = "glass" if short.startswith(("glass", "windshield", "rear_window")) else "light"
        tags = [kind, short.rstrip("_LR").rstrip("_")]
        if short.startswith("headlight"):
            tags.append("headlight")
        if short.startswith("taillight"):
            tags.append("taillight")
        side = "left" if short.endswith("_L") else "right" if short.endswith("_R") else "center"
        x_hint = Y if kind == "glass" else X
        conn = PolygonConnector.from_points(name.replace("aperture/", ""), pts, normal_hint=nrm, x_hint=x_hint,
                                            tags=tags, meta={"grid": list(grid), "grid_points": grid_pts, "side": side, "aperture": True})
        out.append(conn)

    # --------------------------------------------------------- exterior bits
    nose = V[mesh.groups["nose_ring"]]
    tail = V[mesh.groups["tail_ring"]]
    apex_f = V[mesh.groups["apex_front"]][0]
    apex_r = V[mesh.groups["apex_rear"]][0]
    nose_n = _face_normal_from_ring(nose, +1)
    tail_n = _face_normal_from_ring(tail, -1)
    z_nose_top, z_nose_bot = meas["nose_z_top"], meas["nose_z_bottom"]
    z_tail_top, z_tail_bot = meas["tail_z_top"], meas["tail_z_bottom"]
    nose_w = 2 * meas["nose_top_half_width"]
    tail_w = 2 * meas["tail_top_half_width"]

    def on_face(apex, nrm, z, ahead=0.004):
        # point on the fascia plane at height z (shifted along the normal a bit)
        p = np.array([apex[0], 0.0, z])
        # move onto the (raked) face: plane through apex with normal nrm
        d = np.dot(apex - p, nrm) / max(abs(nrm[0]), 1e-6)
        p[0] += d * np.sign(nrm[0])
        return p + nrm * ahead

    grille_z = z_nose_top - 0.18
    out.append(RectangleConnector("grille", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
                                  min(nose_w * 0.62, 1.1), 0.17, tags=["grille"], meta={"style_hint": hints.get("style", "sedan")}))
    intake_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16
    out.append(RectangleConnector("intake", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, intake_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
                                  min(nose_w * 0.8, 1.2), 0.14, tags=["grille", "intake"], meta={"lower": True}))
    plate_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16 + 0.15
    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, (grille_z + intake_z) / 2 - 0.02, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "front"}))
    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.5 * (z_tail_top - z_tail_bot), 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y),
                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
    out.append(PointConnector("badge_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z + 0.11, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y), tags=["badge"]))
    out.append(PointConnector("badge_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_top - 0.16, 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y), tags=["badge"]))
    # exhaust tips
    for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
        p = on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.10, 0.0)
        p[1] = ys * (meas["tail_half_width"] - 0.32)
        out.append(CircleConnector(f"exhaust_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, tail_n, x_hint=Y), 0.038, tags=["exhaust"],
                                   meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
    # side mirrors at the front-bottom corner of the front door glass
    st = station_index
    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
        p = V[vidx(mesh, st("roof_front"), mir(J["F"]))].copy()
        p[0] += 0.02
        p[2] += 0.02
        out.append(PointConnector(f"mirror_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, [0.0, ys, 0.0], x_hint=X), tags=["mirror"],
                                  meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
        # door handles: on the door skin just below the belt, mid-door
        x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
        x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
        for door, x0, x1, ok in (("front", x_fd0, x_fd1, True),
                                 ("rear", x_fd1, meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02, door_count >= 4)):
            if not ok:
                continue
            xh = x1 + 0.62 * (x0 - x1)
            zh = meas["z_belt"] - 0.11
            line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xh, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zh)))
            p = line[k].copy()
            nrm = np.array([0.0, ys, 0.0])
            out.append(PointConnector(f"handle_{door}_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, nrm, x_hint=X), tags=["handle"],
                                      meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door}))
        # roof rails along the roof edge (upper chain is numbered rear -> front)
        i0, i1 = st("roof_rear") + 1, st("roof_front") - 1
        if i1 > i0 + 1:
            pts = np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, mir(J["G"]))] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
            length = float(pts[-1, 0] - pts[0, 0])
            c = pts.mean(axis=0)
            fr = Frame.from_normal(c, Z, x_hint=X)
            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"roof_rail_{side}", fr, abs(length), 0.05, tags=["roof_rail"],
                                          meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "path": pts}))
    # fuel cap on the rear quarter (fuel side from hints)
    fs = hints.get("fuel_side", "left")
    ys = 1.0 if fs == "left" else -1.0
    mir = (lambda j: j) if ys > 0 else mirror_index
    xf = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + 0.08
    line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xf, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
    zf = meas["z_belt"] - 0.20
    k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zf)))
    out.append(CircleConnector("fuel_cap", Frame.from_normal(line[k], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X), 0.065, tags=["fuel_cap"],
                               meta={"side": fs}))
    # antenna / shark fin near the rear of the roof
    i_ant = st("roof_rear") + 1
    p = V[vidx(mesh, i_ant, J["H"])]
    out.append(PointConnector("antenna", Frame.from_normal(p, Z, x_hint=X), tags=["antenna"]))

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- interior
    out += interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
    from .connectors_extra import extra_exterior_connectors
    out += extra_exterior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
    return out


def _face_normal_from_ring(ring: np.ndarray, sign: float) -> np.ndarray:
    top = ring[J["H"]]
    bot = ring[J["A"]]
    d = top - bot  # face direction (mostly vertical, tilted by the rake)
    n = np.array([d[2], 0.0, -d[0]])
    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
    if np.sign(n[0]) != np.sign(sign):
        n = -n
    return n


def interior_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
    V = mesh.vertices
    out: List[Connector] = []
    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
    ysd = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
    st = station_index

    floor = meas["z_floor"] + 0.05             # cabin floor (carpet top)
    inner_half = meas["y_shoulder"] - 0.08     # cabin inner half width at the belt
    roof_h = meas["z_roof_front"]
    h_point = float(hints.get("h_point_height", np.clip(0.17 + (roof_h - 1.2) * 0.4, 0.17, 0.38)))
    x_h1 = meas["x_cowl"] - float(hints.get("front_h_point_offset", 0.95))
    z_h1 = floor + h_point
    y_seat = min(0.42, inner_half - 0.36)
    x_firewall = meas["x_cowl"] + 0.12
    has_bed = meas.get("has_bed", 0.0) > 0.5
    x_cab_rear = min(meas["x_roof_rear"] - 0.05, meas["x_deck"] + 0.55) if not has_bed else meas["x_deck"] - 0.05
    x_cab_rear = min(x_cab_rear, meas["x_roof_rear"] + 0.15)
    # seat rows -----------------------------------------------------------------
    rows_cfg = hints.get("seat_rows", "auto")
    pitch = 0.86
    row_x = [x_h1]
    while len(row_x) < 3 and row_x[-1] - pitch - 0.30 > x_cab_rear - 0.12:
        row_x.append(row_x[-1] - pitch)
    if rows_cfg != "auto":
        rows_cfg = int(rows_cfg)
        row_x = [x_h1 - k * pitch for k in range(max(1, rows_cfg))]
    n_rows = len(row_x)
    seat_w, seat_d = 0.52, 0.55
    for r, xh in enumerate(row_x):
        if r == 0:
            for name, ys in (("driver", ysd), ("passenger", -ysd)):
                fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.12, ys * y_seat, floor], Z, x_hint=X)
                out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_front_{name}", fr, seat_d, seat_w, tags=["seat", "seat_front"],
                                              meta={"row": 0, "role": name, "h_point_height": h_point,
                                                    "headroom": roof_h - 0.03 - floor, "side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
        else:
            bench_w = 2 * inner_half - 0.12
            room = row_x[r - 1] - xh
            fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.10, 0.0, floor + (0.02 if r == 1 else 0.0)], Z, x_hint=X)
            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_row{r + 1}", fr, seat_d - 0.05, bench_w, tags=["seat", "seat_bench", f"seat_row{r + 1}"],
                                          meta={"row": r, "role": "bench", "h_point_height": h_point - 0.02 * r,
                                                "headroom": meas["z_roof_rear"] - 0.03 - floor if r == n_rows - 1 else roof_h - floor,
                                                "legroom": room}))
    # steering wheel / column ---------------------------------------------------
    col_angle = np.radians(float(hints.get("column_angle", 24.0)))
    wheel_c = np.array([x_h1 + 0.52, ysd * y_seat, z_h1 + 0.32])
    n = np.array([-np.cos(col_angle), 0.0, np.sin(col_angle)])
    out.append(CircleConnector("steering_wheel", Frame.from_normal(wheel_c, n, x_hint=Y), 0.185, tags=["steering_wheel"],
                               meta={"column_angle_deg": float(np.degrees(col_angle)), "column_length": 0.35}))
    # dashboard: interior section just behind the windshield base ----------------
    cowl = ring_pts(mesh, st("cowl"))
    yE = cowl[J["E"], 1] - 0.09
    z_top = meas["z_cowl"] - 0.03
    z_lo = floor + 0.32
    x_dash = meas["x_cowl"] - 0.02
    dash_pts = np.array([
        [x_dash, -yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_top - 0.12], [x_dash, yE - 0.10, z_top],
        [x_dash, -yE + 0.10, z_top], [x_dash, -yE, z_top - 0.12],
    ])
    dash = PolygonConnector.from_points("dashboard", dash_pts, normal_hint=-X, x_hint=-Y, tags=["dashboard"],
                                        meta={"driver_y": ysd * y_seat, "depth": 0.55, "floor": floor,
                                              "windshield_x": meas["x_cowl"], "steering_center": wheel_c})
    out.append(dash)
    # pedals ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    out.append(RectangleConnector("pedals", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.86, ysd * y_seat, floor + 0.02], Z, x_hint=X),
                                  0.20, 0.34, tags=["pedals"], meta={"transmission": hints.get("transmission", "automatic")}))
    # centre console between the front seats --------------------------------------
    console_len = 0.95
    out.append(RectangleConnector("console", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.18, 0.0, floor], Z, x_hint=X), console_len, 0.26,
                                  tags=["console"], meta={"height": z_h1 - floor + 0.06, "driver_y": ysd * y_seat}))
    # cabin floor --------------------------------------------------------------------
    fl_len = x_firewall - x_cab_rear
    out.append(RectangleConnector("floor", Frame.from_normal([(x_firewall + x_cab_rear) / 2, 0.0, floor - 0.01], Z, x_hint=X),
                                  fl_len, 2 * inner_half + 0.10, tags=["floor"], meta={"tunnel_height": 0.16, "seat_rows": n_rows}))
    # firewall / bulkheads (simple rectangles so the cabin reads as enclosed)
    out.append(RectangleConnector("firewall", Frame.from_normal([x_firewall, 0.0, (floor + z_lo) / 2], -X, x_hint=-Y),
                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, z_lo - floor + 0.02, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "front"}))
    out.append(RectangleConnector("rear_bulkhead", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear, 0.0, (floor + meas["z_belt"]) / 2], X, x_hint=Y),
                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, meas["z_belt"] - floor, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
    # parcel shelf (sedan) or cargo floor (hatch/wagon)
    if meas["x_deck"] < x_cab_rear - 0.2 and not has_bed:
        length = x_cab_rear - meas["x_deck"]
        out.append(RectangleConnector("parcel_shelf", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - length / 2, 0.0, meas["z_deck"] - 0.10], Z, x_hint=X),
                                      length, 2 * inner_half + 0.05, tags=["shelf"]))
        # trunk floor
        tl = length + 0.2
        out.append(RectangleConnector("trunk_floor", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - tl / 2 - 0.05, 0.0, floor + 0.10], Z, x_hint=X),
                                      tl, 2 * inner_half - 0.1, tags=["cargo_floor"], meta={"enclosed": True}))
    elif not has_bed:
        length = x_cab_rear - (meas["x_rear"] + 0.25)
        if length > 0.3:
            out.append(RectangleConnector("cargo_floor", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - length / 2, 0.0, floor + 0.12], Z, x_hint=X),
                                          length, 2 * inner_half - 0.05, tags=["cargo_floor"], meta={"enclosed": False}))
    # headliner: interior side of the roof (stations run rear -> front) --------------------
    i0, i1 = st("roof_rear"), st("roof_front")
    jG, jH = J["G"], J["H"]
    loop = []
    loop += [vidx(mesh, i, jG) for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, i1, j) for j in range(jG + 1, mirror_index(jG) + 1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, i, mirror_index(jG)) for i in range(i1 - 1, i0 - 1, -1)]
    loop += [vidx(mesh, i0, j) for j in range(mirror_index(jG) - 1, jG, -1)]
    pts = V[loop].copy()
    pts[:, 2] -= 0.035
    hl_grid = np.array([[V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for j in range(jG, mirror_index(jG) + 1)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
    hl_grid[:, :, 2] -= 0.035
    out.append(PolygonConnector.from_points("headliner", pts, normal_hint=-Z, x_hint=X, tags=["headliner"],
                                            meta={"grid": [i1 - i0 + 1, mirror_index(jG) - jG + 1], "grid_points": hl_grid,
                                                  "roof_center_x": (meas["x_roof_front"] + meas["x_roof_rear"]) / 2}))
    # rear-view mirror
    p = V[vidx(mesh, i0 + 1, jH)].copy()
    p[2] -= 0.12
    out.append(PointConnector("rearview_mirror", Frame.from_normal(p, -X, x_hint=Y), tags=["rearview_mirror"]))
    # door cards: interior side of each door ---------------------------------------------
    x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
    x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
    x_rd1 = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
    doors = [("front", x_fd0, x_fd1)]
    if door_count >= 4:
        doors.append(("rear", x_fd1, x_rd1))
    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
        for door, xa, xb in doors:
            ja, jb = mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"])
            front = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xa, ja, jb)
            rear = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xb, ja, jb)
            n_len = 6
            poly = []
            # bottom edge (along the sill) from front to rear, rear edge up, top edge back, front edge down
            for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n_len, endpoint=False):
                poly.append(front[0] + (rear[0] - front[0]) * t)
            poly += list(rear)
            for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n_len, endpoint=False)[1:]:
                poly.append(rear[-1] + (front[-1] - rear[-1]) * t)
            poly += list(front[::-1][:-1])
            poly = np.asarray(poly)
            poly[:, 1] -= ys * 0.09
            poly[:, 2] += 0.02
            out.append(PolygonConnector.from_points(f"door_card_{door}_{side}", poly, normal_hint=[0, -ys, 0], x_hint=X,
                                                    tags=["door_card"], meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door,
                                                                              "grid": [n_len + 1, len(front)], "belt_z": float(meas["z_belt"])}))
    # pickup bed floor connector
    if has_bed:
        deck_r = ring_pts(mesh, st("deck"))
        length = meas["x_deck"] - meas["x_rear"] - 0.1
        out.append(RectangleConnector("bed_floor", Frame.from_normal([meas["x_rear"] + 0.05 + length / 2, 0.0, meas["z_deck"] - meas["bed"] + 0.01], Z, x_hint=X),
                                      length, 2 * (meas["roof_half_width"] - 0.05), tags=["cargo_floor", "bed"], meta={"enclosed": False}))
    from .connectors_extra import extra_interior_connectors
    out += extra_interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
    return out

1	# Task 01 — Body surfacing realism
2	
3	Branch: `agent/body-surfacing`.  Files you own: `makecar/body/generator.py`,
4	`makecar/body/params.py`, `makecar/body/styles.py`, `makecar/body/targets.py`,
5	`makecar/body/connectors.py` (only where noted), tests under `tests/test_body*.py`.
6	Read `docs/tasks/README.md` first.
7	
8	## Goal
9	The body loft is recognisable but generic.  Make it read like a production car
10	body when rendered.  Work through the items below in order; each must be
11	visible in a render and covered by a test where a number can be checked.
12	
13	1. **Front and rear ends.**  Today the nose/tail are a raked ring closed by two
14	   shrunken rings and an apex.  Replace with a proper fascia: a bumper volume
15	   that stands proud of the body sides at the bottom (bumper corner radius in
16	   plan ~0.25 m, in elevation the bumper face is near-vertical from
17	   `front_bumper_bottom` up to a bumper crease at ~0.55–0.65 m, then steps back
18	   ~0.03 m to the hood leading edge which overhangs the grille opening).  Add
19	   parameters (with sensible defaults per style) for bumper crease height, hood
20	   overhang and a front splitter/lower lip; rear: bumper with a licence-plate
21	   recess, a diffuser step at the bottom for sports/coupe, tailgate lower panel
22	   for hatch/wagon/SUV/van.  Keep the apertures (headlight/taillight zones) and
23	   the `nose_ring`/`tail_ring`/`apex_*` vertex groups meaningful so
24	   `emit_connectors` keeps working (grille, plates, badges, exhausts).  Adding
25	   rings to the fascia is fine (bump `N_FASCIA`, `LIBRARY_VERSION`).
26	2. **Fender/hood crease and shoulder.**  Real bodies have a crisp crease where
27	   the fender top meets the hood (and a softer one along the shoulder above the
28	   belt).  Give the section a proper hood-to-fender step and make the shoulder
29	   line (E→F) a definite radius rather than a soft roll; add
30	   `shoulder_radius` and `fender_crease` parameters + modifiers.
31	3. **Rocker and lower body.**  Add a rocker panel with a flat vertical face and
32	   a lower flare-in to the underbody (a real sill is ~0.15 m tall, slightly
33	   inboard of the door skin); doors should tuck under to the sill with a small
34	   step (door bottom edge).  Wheel-arch lips: a flange ~0.02 m wide standing
35	   proud of the fender, following the arch, not just a bulge.
36	4. **Greenhouse.**  Glass must sit ~8 mm below the pillar surface (recess the
37	   F→G glass strip slightly and the roof-arc glass zones) with a visible frame
38	   band; add a drip rail / roof edge radius; A-pillar and C-pillar widths as
39	   parameters.  Side glass top edge should follow the roof rail curve, not a
40	   straight line.
41	5. **Underbody.**  A flat floor pan with a longitudinal tunnel bump (only
42	   visible in low renders), rear valance under the bumper, front air dam.
43	6. **Style presets.**  Tune the eight presets against real reference
44	   dimensions (state your references in the report — e.g. Camry/Golf/Outback/
45	   RAV4/F-150/Mustang/MX-5/Sienna).  Windshield rake, cowl height, belt line,
46	   roof height, overhangs and wheel size must be within a few cm of the class.
47	
48	## Acceptance
49	* `python3 -m pytest -q` green, new tests for each new parameter's effect
50	  (measure the mesh: e.g. bumper face stands proud by ≥ the parameter value).
51	* `docs/agent_reports/01_body_surfacing/`: before/after renders for sedan,
52	  hatchback, suv, pickup, sports from front-3/4, rear-3/4, side, front, plus a
53	  close-up of the nose and of the A-pillar/glass recess.  Use
54	  `makecar.pipeline.build_car` + `Renderer` (see `render_views`).
55	* All 15 sample configs still build via `python -m makecar samples -o /tmp/x`
56	  (you may need to update presets/params; keep config keys backward compatible).
57	* REPORT.md as described in the README of this folder.
58

1	# Agent task briefs
2	
3	Each file here is a self-contained brief for an autonomous coding agent working
4	on one realism work stream, on its own branch/worktree.  Shared ground rules
5	for every brief:
6	
7	* Read `README.md`, then the files the brief names.  Run `python3 -m pytest -q`
8	  before you start (it must be green) and before you finish (it must be green,
9	  and you must ADD tests for what you build).
10	* World frame: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, ground z=0, metres.  Origin at the
11	  wheelbase midpoint.  Real-world scale matters: check every dimension you
12	  introduce against a real car.
13	* LOOK at your work.  `makecar.export.render.Renderer` renders PNGs
14	  (see `makecar/pipeline.py: render_views` and `cutaway_mesh`).  Write
15	  before/after comparison images into `docs/agent_reports/<task>/` and view
16	  them (the Read tool shows PNGs).  Do not declare something realistic without
17	  having looked at it from at least three angles, including a close-up.
18	* The body's fixed-topology invariant is sacred: `BodyGenerator` must return the
19	  same vertex/face count and face index tuples for ALL styles and parameter
20	  values (tests enforce it).  If you change `SEGMENTS`, station counts or the
21	  cap construction, bump `LIBRARY_VERSION` in `makecar/body/targets.py` and make
22	  sure connectors, zones, groups and seams still line up.
23	* Do not break the connector contract that components rely on (names, tags,
24	  frame conventions, meta keys documented in `makecar/body/connectors.py`).
25	  New connectors go in `makecar/body/connectors_extra.py`.
26	* Keep meshes light: a full car should stay under ~120k faces.  Prefer quads
27	  and lofts; use `makecar/geometry/primitives.py`.
28	* Commit on your branch in small, described commits (git user is preconfigured).
29	  No pushing.  When done, write `docs/agent_reports/<task>/REPORT.md`: what
30	  changed, what you verified and how, open issues, screenshots list.

1	# makecar — MakeHuman for cars
2	
3	![the eight body styles](docs/images/lineup_styles.png)
4	
5	`makecar` procedurally models complete cars — exterior **and** interior — from a
6	config file, using the same ideas that make [MakeHuman](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/)
7	work for people:
8	
9	| MakeHuman                         | makecar                                                     |
10	|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
11	| one base mesh, fixed topology     | one parametric body loft with fixed topology (`body/generator.py`) |
12	| targets = per-vertex offsets      | `Target` objects, differential + sculpted (`morph/`, `body/targets.py`) |
13	| modifiers / sliders in [-1, 1]    | `Modifier`s: 39 shape sliders, 4 sculpts, 7 style macros    |
14	| macro targets (gender, age …)     | style macros: hatchback, wagon, suv, pickup, coupe, sports, van |
15	| joints / landmarks follow the mesh| **connectors** derived from vertex groups of the morphed mesh |
16	| proxies / clothes fitted to body  | **components** fitted to connectors, themselves target-based |
17	
18	```
19	config.yaml ──► CarBody (base + targets) ──► body mesh + connectors
20	                                                  │
21	                     components (wheel, seat, dashboard …) fitted to connectors
22	                     (components can emit connectors of their own → recursive)
23	                                                  │
24	                    output/<name>/  car.obj  body.obj  connectors.json  assembly.json
25	                                    blueprint.svg  connector_map.svg  preview.png  interior.png  spec.txt
26	```
27	
28	![sedan hero](docs/images/hero_family_sedan.png)
29	![sedan interior](docs/images/interior_family_sedan.png)
30	![slider sweeps](docs/images/slider_sweeps.png)
31	
32	## Quick start
33	
34	```bash
35	pip install numpy pyyaml            # the only runtime dependencies
36	python -m makecar samples -o output # builds every config in configs/ (the shipped samples)
37	python -m makecar build configs/coupe.yaml -o output --set wheelbase=0.4 --seed 3
38	python -m makecar list-modifiers    # all sliders with their groups and ranges
39	python -m makecar list-components   # registered components, what they accept, what they default for
40	python -m makecar connectors configs/suv.yaml   # every connector a config produces and what attaches
41	python -m makecar random -n 4 --style hatchback -o output   # random variations
42	python -m pytest -q                 # test-suite
43	```
44	
45	The first run builds the body target library (~4 s) and caches it in
46	`~/.cache/makecar/` (override with `MAKECAR_CACHE`); afterwards a car builds in
47	well under a second, plus a few seconds for the PNG previews (pure-numpy
48	rasteriser — no renderer dependency).
49	
50	## Config file
51	
52	```yaml
53	name: gt_coupe
54	description: Two-door GT with muscular haunches
55	seed: 6
56	body:
57	  style: coupe                    # a macro target, or a blend: {suv: 0.7, coupe: 0.3}
58	  modifiers:                      # MakeHuman-style sliders in [-1, 1]
59	    cowl_offset: 0.3              #   long hood
60	    roof_height: -0.15
61	    width: 0.2
62	  sculpt: {haunches: 0.8, wedge: 0.5}   # hand-authored procedural targets
63	  hints: {door_count: 2, drive: left, transmission: manual, seat_rows: auto, fuel_side: left}
64	  random: {amount: 0.0}           # jitter the sliders for variations (uses `seed`)
65	palette: {paint: "#151820", interior: "#3a1f1c", seat: "#6b2f28", rim: "#d0d3d8"}
66	components:
67	  defaults: true                  # attach the default component to every connector
68	  disable: [antenna, roof_rail*]  # selectors: connector name, tag or glob
69	  assign:                         # override component and/or options per selector
70	    wheel: {component: wheel.alloy, options: {spokes: 10, spoke_width: 0.4}}
71	    exhaust: {component: exhaust.tip, options: {dual: true}}
72	    roof_rail: roof.rails         # opt-in component for a connector with no default
73	output:
74	  formats: [obj, svg, png, json]  # add "targets" to also dump the used targets as .target files
75	  views: [three_quarter_front, three_quarter_rear, side, top, front, rear, interior_cutaway, interior_side, driver]
76	  blueprint_theme: blueprint      # or "paper"; blueprint_connectors: true overlays every connector on the sheet
77	variants:                         # more cars from the same file (deep-merged over the base config)
78	  - name: gt_coupe_wide
79	    body: {modifiers: {width: 0.8}}
80	```
81	
82	`body.base_params` (advanced) regenerates the *base* mesh with different
83	canonical parameters; targets are still applied on top, exactly like editing the
84	MakeHuman base mesh.
85	
86	## The body: a fixed-topology loft with targets
87	
88	`body/generator.py` lofts 45 cross-section rings (64 vertices each) plus two
89	fascia caps. Every ring is sampled from ten *semantic* control points —
90	floor edge, wheel-well, sill, belt line, shoulder, roof rail, roof centre … —
91	with a fixed number of samples per segment, so vertex *j* of every ring is
92	always the same feature (sill, glass base, roof rail …) no matter what the
93	parameters are. Two independent chains of longitudinal breakpoints (wheel arches
94	vs. greenhouse features) share the ring index, which lets both wheel arches and
95	window apertures have clean edges without ever changing topology.
96	
97	Because the topology is fixed, `body/targets.py` derives targets exactly the way
98	MakeHuman targets were made: generate a variant, subtract the base.
99	
100	* 39 **differential modifiers** (`wheelbase`, `roof_height`, `windshield_length`,
101	  `a_pillar_lean`, `bed_depth`, …) each with a `-incr`/`-decr` target pair.
102	* 7 **style macros** (`style/hatchback` … `style/van`) — full presets turned into
103	  unipolar targets; they blend (`{sedan: 0.5, wagon: 0.5}` is a shooting brake).
104	* 4 **sculpt targets** written as displacement fields (`sculpt/haunches`,
105	  `sculpt/side_crease`, `sculpt/wedge`, `sculpt/roof_bubble`).
106	
107	The body mesh carries *zones* (apertures for glass and lamps, underbody, wheel
108	wells, bed) and *vertex groups* (arch lips, feature lines, rings at the cowl /
109	pillars / deck, nose & tail). Apertures are cut out of the shell and handed to
110	components as polygon connectors.
111	
112	## Connectors
113	
114	`connectors.py`:
115	
116	```
117	Connector
118	 ├── PointConnector                  mirrors, handles, badges, antenna, shifter, grab handles …
119	 └── PolygonConnector                windows, lamps, dashboard, headliner, door cards
120	      ├── RectangleConnector         seats, grille, plates, console, floor, pedals, cluster, screen …
121	      └── CircleConnector            wheels, steering wheel, exhaust, fuel cap, vents, speakers, cup holders
122	```
123	
124	Each connector has a `Frame` (origin + axes; Z = mount normal, X = major
125	direction), `tags` used by the config selectors, and `meta` hints (tyre width,
126	H-point height, driver side, grid shape of an aperture …). The body emits ~50 of
127	them, all computed from vertex groups and measurements of the *morphed* mesh, so
128	they follow every slider. Components can emit sub-connectors (the dashboard
129	offers a gauge cluster, screen, vents, glove box, HVAC; the console offers a
130	shifter and cup holders; door cards offer speakers …) and the assembler resolves
131	them recursively.
132	
133	Type matching uses the class hierarchy: a component that `accepts =
134	(PolygonConnector,)` attaches to rectangles and circles too.
135	
136	## Components
137	
138	`components/base.py` defines two flavours:
139	
140	* `CarComponent` — plain procedural (grille, plates, lamps, mirrors, …).
141	* `MorphableComponent` — **the same logic as the body**: a dataclass of canonical
142	  parameters, a fixed-topology `generate()`, a list of `ModifierSpec`s turned into
143	  differential targets by `DifferentialTargetBuilder`, optional variant macros,
144	  and a `fit()` that maps the connector's geometry (radius, width, height,
145	  meta) onto slider values. `Wheel`, the seats, the dashboard and the steering
146	  wheel work this way, so a wheel connector with a bigger radius simply drives
147	  the `radius` slider of the wheel library.
148	
149	Polygon-type components use `components/fills.py`: apertures come with the
150	grid shape of the loft region they were cut from, so a Coons patch reproduces the
151	body's curvature exactly (windshields stay double-curved; lamps wrap the corner).
152	
153	Register your own with `@register` and set `default_for` to the tags it should
154	take over by default, or select it explicitly in the config.
155	
156	## Output folder
157	
158	Each car gets `output/<name>/` with:
159	
160	* `car.obj` + `car.mtl` — full assembly (object groups per component, materials)
161	* `body.obj` — the morphed shell alone, apertures removed
162	* `connectors.json` — every connector: kind, frame, outline/size, tags, meta, attached component
163	* `assembly.json` — effective modifier values, measurements, component tree, timings
164	* `blueprint.svg` — A3 general-arrangement sheet: side/front/plan/rear views with mm dimensions, interior plan and centre-plane section, title block
165	* `connector_map.svg` — side + plan views with every connector drawn and labelled (colour-coded by kind)
166	* `preview.png`, `interior.png` — rendered views (roof cutaway, half-cut, driver's eye)
167	* `spec.txt` — human-readable summary
168	
169	`output/README.md` (written by `samples`) indexes all generated cars.
170	
171	## Layout
172	
173	```
174	makecar/
175	  geometry/    mesh container, frames, curves, primitives
176	  morph/       Target, Modifier, MorphableMesh, DifferentialTargetBuilder
177	  body/        params, generator (loft), styles (macros), targets, connectors, CarBody
178	  components/  base API + fills, exterior.py, interior.py
179	  export/      obj, svg blueprint, png rasteriser
180	  connectors.py  assembly.py  config.py  pipeline.py  cli.py
181	configs/       sample configs        tests/   pytest suite
182	```
183

1	# Task 01 — Body surfacing realism
2	
3	Branch: `agent/body-surfacing`.  Files you own: `makecar/body/generator.py`,
4	`makecar/body/params.py`, `makecar/body/styles.py`, `makecar/body/targets.py`,
5	`makecar/body/connectors.py` (only where noted), tests under `tests/test_body*.py`.
6	Read `docs/tasks/README.md` first.
7	
8	## Goal
9	The body loft is recognisable but generic.  Make it read like a production car
10	body when rendered.  Work through the items below in order; each must be
11	visible in a render and covered by a test where a number can be checked.
12	
13	1. **Front and rear ends.**  Today the nose/tail are a raked ring closed by two
14	   shrunken rings and an apex.  Replace with a proper fascia: a bumper volume
15	   that stands proud of the body sides at the bottom (bumper corner radius in
16	   plan ~0.25 m, in elevation the bumper face is near-vertical from
17	   `front_bumper_bottom` up to a bumper crease at ~0.55–0.65 m, then steps back
18	   ~0.03 m to the hood leading edge which overhangs the grille opening).  Add
19	   parameters (with sensible defaults per style) for bumper crease height, hood
20	   overhang and a front splitter/lower lip; rear: bumper with a licence-plate
21	   recess, a diffuser step at the bottom for sports/coupe, tailgate lower panel
22	   for hatch/wagon/SUV/van.  Keep the apertures (headlight/taillight zones) and
23	   the `nose_ring`/`tail_ring`/`apex_*` vertex groups meaningful so
24	   `emit_connectors` keeps working (grille, plates, badges, exhausts).  Adding
25	   rings to the fascia is fine (bump `N_FASCIA`, `LIBRARY_VERSION`).
26	2. **Fender/hood crease and shoulder.**  Real bodies have a crisp crease where
27	   the fender top meets the hood (and a softer one along the shoulder above the
28	   belt).  Give the section a proper hood-to-fender step and make the shoulder
29	   line (E→F) a definite radius rather than a soft roll; add
30	   `shoulder_radius` and `fender_crease` parameters + modifiers.
31	3. **Rocker and lower body.**  Add a rocker panel with a flat vertical face and
32	   a lower flare-in to the underbody (a real sill is ~0.15 m tall, slightly
33	   inboard of the door skin); doors should tuck under to the sill with a small
34	   step (door bottom edge).  Wheel-arch lips: a flange ~0.02 m wide standing
35	   proud of the fender, following the arch, not just a bulge.
36	4. **Greenhouse.**  Glass must sit ~8 mm below the pillar surface (recess the
37	   F→G glass strip slightly and the roof-arc glass zones) with a visible frame
38	   band; add a drip rail / roof edge radius; A-pillar and C-pillar widths as
39	   parameters.  Side glass top edge should follow the roof rail curve, not a
40	   straight line.
41	5. **Underbody.**  A flat floor pan with a longitudinal tunnel bump (only
42	   visible in low renders), rear valance under the bumper, front air dam.
43	6. **Style presets.**  Tune the eight presets against real reference
44	   dimensions (state your references in the report — e.g. Camry/Golf/Outback/
45	   RAV4/F-150/Mustang/MX-5/Sienna).  Windshield rake, cowl height, belt line,
46	   roof height, overhangs and wheel size must be within a few cm of the class.
47	
48	## Acceptance
49	* `python3 -m pytest -q` green, new tests for each new parameter's effect
50	  (measure the mesh: e.g. bumper face stands proud by ≥ the parameter value).
51	* `docs/agent_reports/01_body_surfacing/`: before/after renders for sedan,
52	  hatchback, suv, pickup, sports from front-3/4, rear-3/4, side, front, plus a

1	"""End-to-end: config -> body -> assembly -> output folder."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import json
5	import time
6	from dataclasses import dataclass
7	from pathlib import Path
8	from typing import Dict, List, Optional
9	import numpy as np
10	
11	from .config import CarConfig
12	from .body import CarBody, BodyResult
13	from .body.styles import STYLE_DESCRIPTIONS
14	from .assembly import assemble, CarAssembly
15	from .export.obj import write_obj
16	from .export.render import Renderer, Camera
17	from .export.png import write_png
18	from .geometry.mesh import Mesh
19	
20	
21	@dataclass
22	class BuildOutput:
23	    config: CarConfig
24	    body: BodyResult
25	    assembly: CarAssembly
26	    out_dir: Optional[Path]
27	    files: List[Path]
28	    timings: Dict[str, float]
29	
30	
31	_BODY_CACHE: Dict[tuple, CarBody] = {}
32	
33	
34	def car_body_for(cfg: CarConfig) -> CarBody:
35	    params = cfg.base_params()
36	    key = tuple(sorted(params.to_dict().items()))
37	    if key not in _BODY_CACHE:
38	        _BODY_CACHE[key] = CarBody(params)
39	    return _BODY_CACHE[key]
40	
41	
42	def randomised_modifiers(cfg: CarConfig, body: CarBody) -> Dict[str, float]:
43	    """Apply body.random jitter on top of the configured modifiers."""
44	    mods = dict(cfg.body.get("modifiers") or {})
45	    rnd = cfg.body.get("random") or {}
46	    amount = float(rnd.get("amount", 0.0) or 0.0)
47	    if amount <= 0:
48	        return mods
49	    rng = np.random.default_rng(cfg.seed)
50	    groups = set(rnd.get("groups") or [])
51	    exclude = set(rnd.get("exclude") or [])
52	    for name, mod in body.library.modifiers.items():
53	        if mod.group in groups and name not in exclude and name not in mods and not mod.is_unipolar:
54	            mods[name] = float(np.clip(rng.normal(0.0, amount * 0.5), -amount, amount))
55	    return mods
56	
57	
58	def build_car(cfg: CarConfig) -> tuple[BodyResult, CarAssembly, Dict[str, float]]:
59	    timings: Dict[str, float] = {}
60	    t = time.time()
61	    body = car_body_for(cfg)
62	    timings["library"] = time.time() - t
63	    t = time.time()
64	    mods = randomised_modifiers(cfg, body)
65	    res = body.build(cfg.body.get("style", "sedan"), mods, cfg.body.get("sculpt") or {}, cfg.hints(),
66	                     paint=cfg.palette().paint)
67	    timings["body"] = time.time() - t
68	    t = time.time()
69	    asm = assemble(res, cfg.components, cfg.palette(), cfg.seed)
70	    timings["assembly"] = time.time() - t
71	    return res, asm, timings
72	
73	
74	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ views
75	def _camera(view: str, mesh_bounds, meas: Dict[str, float], asm: CarAssembly) -> tuple[Camera, dict]:
76	    lo, hi = mesh_bounds
77	    c = (lo + hi) / 2
78	    c[2] = 0.72
79	    L = float(hi[0] - lo[0])
80	    d = 2.05 * L
81	    if view == "three_quarter_front":
82	        return Camera.orbit(c, d, 35, 16, fov_deg=30), {}
83	    if view == "three_quarter_rear":
84	        return Camera.orbit(c, d, -140, 18, fov_deg=30), {}
85	    if view == "side":
86	        return Camera.orbit(c, 4 * L, 90, 0, ortho=True, ortho_height=L * 0.52), {}
87	    if view == "top":
88	        return Camera.orbit(c, 4 * L, 90, 89.9, ortho=True, ortho_height=L * 0.52), {}
89	    if view == "front":
90	        return Camera.orbit(c, 4 * L, 0, 0, ortho=True, ortho_height=2.4), {}
91	    if view == "rear":
92	        return Camera.orbit(c, 4 * L, 180, 0, ortho=True, ortho_height=2.4), {}
93	    if view == "interior_cutaway":
94	        cc = c.copy()
95	        cc[2] = 0.75
96	        return Camera.orbit(cc, 1.45 * L, 42, 42, fov_deg=32), {"cutaway": True}
97	    if view == "interior_side":
98	        cc = c.copy()
99	        cc[2] = 0.8
100	        return Camera.orbit(cc, 0.95 * L, 96, 12, fov_deg=40), {"clip_y": -0.04}
101	    if view == "driver":
102	        try:
103	            seat = asm.body.connector("seat_front_driver")
104	            hp = seat.meta.get("h_point_height", 0.27)
105	            o = seat.origin
106	            eye = np.array([o[0] - 0.15, o[1], o[2] + hp + 0.64])
107	            target = np.array([o[0] + 2.5, o[1] * 0.35, o[2] + hp + 0.42])
108	        except KeyError:
109	            eye = np.array([c[0], 0.4, 1.1])
110	            target = eye + np.array([3, 0, -0.2])
111	        return Camera(eye, target, fov_deg=78), {}
112	    raise KeyError(f"unknown view {view!r}")
113	
114	
115	CUTAWAY_HIDE_TAGS = {"glass", "headliner", "antenna", "roof_rail", "rearview_mirror", "dome_light", "grab_handle", "mirror"}
116	
117	
118	def cutaway_mesh(asm: CarAssembly) -> Mesh:
119	    """Body below the belt line + every component except the roof-related ones:
120	    a clean 'roof off' view of the interior without cut-face shards."""
121	    body = asm.body.mesh
122	    zc = asm.body.measurements["z_belt"] + 0.06
123	    vz = body.vertices[:, 2]
124	    keep = [i for i, f in enumerate(body.faces) if vz[list(f)].max() < zc]
125	    m = body.subset(keep)
126	    m.lines = [l for l in body.lines if l[:, 2].max() < zc]
127	    m.line_names = list(body.line_names[: len(m.lines)])
128	    m.materials.update(body.materials)
129	    for inst in asm.instances:
130	        top = inst.connector
131	        root = asm.body.connector(top.name.split("/")[0]) if "/" in top.name else top
132	        if root.tags & CUTAWAY_HIDE_TAGS or top.tags & CUTAWAY_HIDE_TAGS:
133	            continue
134	        m.merge(inst.result.mesh)
135	    return m
136	
137	
138	def render_views(asm: CarAssembly, views: List[str], size=(1200, 800)) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
139	    full = asm.mesh()
140	    b = full.bounds()
141	    out = {}
142	    W, H = int(size[0]), int(size[1])
143	    cut = None
144	    for v in views:
145	        cam, kw = _camera(v, b, asm.body.measurements, asm)
146	        w, h = (W, H)
147	        if v in ("side", "top"):
148	            w, h = W, int(H * 0.55)
149	        if v in ("front", "rear"):
150	            w, h = int(W * 0.5), int(H * 0.7)
151	        target = full
152	        if kw.pop("cutaway", False):
153	            cut = cutaway_mesh(asm) if cut is None else cut
154	            target = cut
155	        img = Renderer(w, h, 2).render(target, cam, **kw)
156	        out[v] = img
157	    return out
158	
159	
160	def compose_sheets(images: Dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
161	    sheets = {}
162	    ext_rows = []
163	    if "three_quarter_front" in images or "three_quarter_rear" in images:
164	        ext_rows.append(Renderer.hstack([images[k] for k in ("three_quarter_front", "three_quarter_rear") if k in images]))
165	    if "side" in images or "top" in images:
166	        ext_rows.append(Renderer.hstack([images[k] for k in ("side", "top") if k in images]))
167	    if "front" in images or "rear" in images:
168	        ext_rows.append(Renderer.hstack([images[k] for k in ("front", "rear") if k in images]))
169	    if ext_rows:
170	        sheets["preview"] = Renderer.vstack(ext_rows)
171	    int_imgs = [images[k] for k in ("interior_cutaway", "interior_side", "driver") if k in images]
172	    if int_imgs:
173	        sheets["interior"] = Renderer.hstack(int_imgs)
174	    return sheets

200	            **asm.to_dict(),
201	            "mesh": full.stats(),
202	            "timings_s": {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in timings.items()},
203	        }
204	        (out_dir / "assembly.json").write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=1, default=str))
205	        files.append(out_dir / "assembly.json")
206	        (out_dir / "spec.txt").write_text(spec_text(cfg, res, asm))
207	        files.append(out_dir / "spec.txt")
208	    if "targets" in formats:
209	        tdir = out_dir / "targets"
210	        tdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
211	        body = car_body_for(cfg)
212	        for name, value in res.modifier_values.items():
213	            mod = body.library.modifiers[name]
214	            for tgt, w in mod.weights(value):
215	                p = tdir / (tgt.name + ".target")

222	        except ImportError as e:  # pragma: no cover
223	            print(f"  [svg] exporter unavailable: {e}")
224	        else:
225	            theme = cfg.output.get("blueprint_theme", "blueprint")

244	def spec_text(cfg: CarConfig, res: BodyResult, asm: CarAssembly) -> str:
245	    m = res.measurements
246	    lines = [f"{cfg.name}", "=" * len(cfg.name), ""]
247	    if cfg.raw.get("description"):
248	        lines += [cfg.raw["description"], ""]
249	    lines += [
250	        f"style:          {cfg.body.get('style')}",
251	        f"modifiers:      {json.dumps(res.modifier_values)}",
252	        "",
253	        "Dimensions (m)",
254	        f"  length        {m['length']:.3f}",
255	        f"  width         {m['width']:.3f}",
256	        f"  height        {m['height']:.3f}",
257	        f"  wheelbase     {m['wheelbase']:.3f}",
258	        f"  track         {m['track']:.3f}",
259	        f"  ground clr.   {m['z_floor']:.3f}",
260	        f"  tyre radius   {m['arch_front_r'] - res.hints.get('arch_gap', 0.06):.3f}",
261	        f"  belt line     {m['z_belt']:.3f}",
262	        f"  cowl          x={m['x_cowl']:.3f} z={m['z_cowl']:.3f}",
263	        f"  roof          x={m['x_roof_front']:.3f}..{m['x_roof_rear']:.3f} z={m['z_roof_front']:.3f}",
264	        "",
265	        f"Connectors: {len(asm.connectors)}  Components: {len(asm.instances)}  Faces: {asm.to_dict()['stats']['body_faces'] + asm.to_dict()['stats']['component_faces']}",
266	        "",
267	        "Component tree",
268	    ]
269	    by_parent: Dict[Optional[str], List] = {}
270	    for inst in asm.instances:
271	        by_parent.setdefault(inst.parent, []).append(inst)
272	
273	    def walk(parent, indent):
274	        for inst in by_parent.get(parent, []):
275	            lines.append(f"{'  ' * indent}- {inst.connector.name} [{inst.connector.kind}] -> {inst.component}")
276	            walk(inst.id, indent + 1)
277	
278	    walk(None, 1)
279	    if asm.unattached:
280	        lines += ["", "Unattached connectors: " + ", ".join(asm.unattached)]
281	    if asm.disabled:
282	        lines += ["Disabled connectors: " + ", ".join(asm.disabled)]
283	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

286	def run_config(cfg: CarConfig, out_root: Path, with_variants: bool = True, quiet=False) -> List[BuildOutput]:
287	    outputs = []
288	    cfgs = [cfg] + (cfg.variants() if with_variants else [])
289	    for c in cfgs:
290	        t0 = time.time()
291	        res, asm, timings = build_car(c)
292	        out_dir = Path(out_root) / c.name
293	        files = write_outputs(c, res, asm, out_dir, timings)
294	        timings["total"] = time.time() - t0
295	        if not quiet:
296	            st = asm.to_dict()["stats"]
297	            print(f"  {c.name:28s} {st['connectors']:3d} connectors  {st['components']:3d} components  "
298	                  f"{st['body_faces'] + st['component_faces']:6d} faces  {timings['total']:.1f}s  -> {out_dir}")
299	        outputs.append(BuildOutput(c, res, asm, out_dir, files, timings))
300	    return outputs
