207	# --------------------------------------------------------------- connectors
208	def emit_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
209	    """All connectors the body emits.  `hints` carries non-geometric options:
210	    door_count, seat_rows ('auto'|int), drive ('left'|'right'), fuel_side."""
211	    V = mesh.vertices
212	    out: List[Connector] = []
213	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
214	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
215	    ysign_driver = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
216	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
217	
218	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- wheels
219	    tire_w = float(hints.get("tire_width", 0.225))
220	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
221	        cx, cz, r = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], meas[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], meas[f"arch_{tag}_r"]
222	        tire_r = r - float(hints.get("arch_gap", 0.06))
223	        y = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] - tire_w / 2 - 0.01
224	        for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
225	            fr = Frame.from_normal([cx, ys * y, cz], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X)
226	            out.append(CircleConnector(f"wheel_{tag}_{side}", fr, tire_r, tags=["wheel", f"wheel_{tag}"],
227	                                       meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "axle": tag,
228	                                             "tire_width": tire_w, "arch_radius": r, "steer": tag == "front"}))
229	
230	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- apertures
231	    for name in mesh.meta["aperture_rects"]:
232	        pts, grid, nrm, grid_pts = aperture_loop(mesh, name)
233	        short = name.split("/", 1)[1]
234	        kind = "glass" if short.startswith(("glass", "windshield", "rear_window")) else "light"
235	        tags = [kind, short.rstrip("_LR").rstrip("_")]
236	        if short.startswith("headlight"):
237	            tags.append("headlight")
238	        if short.startswith("taillight"):
239	            tags.append("taillight")
240	        side = "left" if short.endswith("_L") else "right" if short.endswith("_R") else "center"
241	        x_hint = Y if kind == "glass" else X
242	        conn = PolygonConnector.from_points(name.replace("aperture/", ""), pts, normal_hint=nrm, x_hint=x_hint,
243	                                            tags=tags, meta={"grid": list(grid), "grid_points": grid_pts, "side": side, "aperture": True})
244	        out.append(conn)
245	
246	    # --------------------------------------------------------- exterior bits
247	    nose = V[mesh.groups["nose_ring"]]
248	    tail = V[mesh.groups["tail_ring"]]
249	    apex_f = V[mesh.groups["apex_front"]][0]
250	    apex_r = V[mesh.groups["apex_rear"]][0]
251	    nose_n, tail_n = X, -X
252	    z_nose_top, z_nose_bot = meas["nose_z_top"], meas["nose_z_bottom"]
253	    z_tail_top, z_tail_bot = meas["tail_z_top"], meas["tail_z_bottom"]
254	    nose_w = 2 * meas["nose_top_half_width"]
255	    tail_w = 2 * meas["tail_top_half_width"]
256	
257	    def on_face(apex, nrm, z, ahead=0.004, y=0.0):
258	        end = "front" if nrm[0] > 0 else "rear"
259	        return fascia_point(mesh, end, z, y) + nrm * ahead
260	
261	    grille_z = z_nose_top - 0.18
262	    out.append(RectangleConnector("grille", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
263	                                  min(nose_w * 0.62, 1.1), 0.17, tags=["grille"], meta={"style_hint": hints.get("style", "sedan")}))
264	    intake_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16
265	    out.append(RectangleConnector("intake", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, intake_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
266	                                  min(nose_w * 0.8, 1.2), 0.14, tags=["grille", "intake"], meta={"lower": True}))
267	    plate_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16 + 0.15
268	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, (grille_z + intake_z) / 2 - 0.02, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
269	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "front"}))
270	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.5 * (z_tail_top - z_tail_bot), 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y),
271	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
272	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z + 0.11, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y), tags=["badge"]))
273	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_top - 0.16, 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y), tags=["badge"]))
274	    # exhaust tips
275	    for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
276	        p = on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.10, 0.0,
277	                    y=ys * (meas["tail_half_width"] - 0.32))
278	        out.append(CircleConnector(f"exhaust_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, tail_n, x_hint=Y), 0.038, tags=["exhaust"],
279	                                   meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
280	    # side mirrors at the front-bottom corner of the front door glass
281	    st = station_index
282	    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
283	        p = V[vidx(mesh, st("roof_front"), mir(J["F"]))].copy()
284	        p[0] += 0.02
285	        p[2] += 0.02
286	        out.append(PointConnector(f"mirror_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, [0.0, ys, 0.0], x_hint=X), tags=["mirror"],
287	                                  meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
288	        # door handles: on the door skin just below the belt, mid-door
289	        x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
290	        x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
291	        for door, x0, x1, ok in (("front", x_fd0, x_fd1, True),
292	                                 ("rear", x_fd1, meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02, door_count >= 4)):
293	            if not ok:
294	                continue
295	            xh = x1 + 0.62 * (x0 - x1)
296	            zh = meas["z_belt"] - 0.11
297	            line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xh, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
298	            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zh)))
299	            p = line[k].copy()
300	            nrm = np.array([0.0, ys, 0.0])
301	            out.append(PointConnector(f"handle_{door}_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, nrm, x_hint=X), tags=["handle"],
302	                                      meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door}))
303	        # roof rails along the roof edge (upper chain is numbered rear -> front)
304	        i0, i1 = st("roof_rear") + 1, st("roof_front") - 1
305	        if i1 > i0 + 1:
306	            pts = np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, mir(J["G"]))] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
307	            length = float(pts[-1, 0] - pts[0, 0])
308	            c = pts.mean(axis=0)
309	            fr = Frame.from_normal(c, Z, x_hint=X)
310	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"roof_rail_{side}", fr, abs(length), 0.05, tags=["roof_rail"],
311	                                          meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "path": pts}))
312	    # fuel cap on the rear quarter (fuel side from hints)
313	    fs = hints.get("fuel_side", "left")
314	    ys = 1.0 if fs == "left" else -1.0
315	    mir = (lambda j: j) if ys > 0 else mirror_index
316	    xf = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + 0.08
317	    line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xf, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
318	    zf = meas["z_belt"] - 0.20
319	    k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zf)))
320	    out.append(CircleConnector("fuel_cap", Frame.from_normal(line[k], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X), 0.065, tags=["fuel_cap"],
321	                               meta={"side": fs}))
322	    # antenna / shark fin near the rear of the roof
323	    i_ant = st("roof_rear") + 1
324	    p = V[vidx(mesh, i_ant, J["H"])]
325	    out.append(PointConnector("antenna", Frame.from_normal(p, Z, x_hint=X), tags=["antenna"]))
326	
327	    # -------------------------------------------------------------- interior
328	    out += interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
329	    from .connectors_extra import extra_exterior_connectors

334	def _face_normal_from_ring(ring: np.ndarray, sign: float) -> np.ndarray:
335	    top = ring[J["H"]]
336	    bot = ring[J["A"]]
337	    d = top - bot  # face direction (mostly vertical, tilted by the rake)
338	    n = np.array([d[2], 0.0, -d[0]])
339	    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
340	    if np.sign(n[0]) != np.sign(sign):
341	        n = -n
342	    return n

347	    out: List[Connector] = []

1	"""Derive measurements, feature lines (seams) and connectors from a morphed body.
2	
3	Everything here reads *vertex groups* and the aperture grid recorded by the
4	generator, never the generator parameters, so connectors follow the mesh
5	wherever the targets move it (the MakeHuman "joints follow the mesh" idea).
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
10	import numpy as np
11	
12	from ..geometry.mesh import Mesh
13	from ..geometry.frame import Frame
14	from ..connectors import Connector, PointConnector, PolygonConnector, RectangleConnector, CircleConnector
15	from .generator import RING, RING_N, HALF_N, N_STATIONS, mirror_index, station_index
16	
17	J = RING  # shorthand: J["F"] etc.
18	
19	
20	# ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
21	def vidx(mesh: Mesh, station: int, j: int) -> int:
22	    return (station + mesh.meta["ring_offset"]) * RING_N + j
23	
24	
25	def ring_pts(mesh: Mesh, station: int) -> np.ndarray:
26	    a = vidx(mesh, station, 0)
27	    return mesh.vertices[a : a + RING_N]
28	
29	
30	def fit_circle(pts_xz: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
31	    """Algebraic least-squares circle fit in 2-D -> (cx, cz, r)."""
32	    x, y = pts_xz[:, 0], pts_xz[:, 1]
33	    A = np.column_stack([x, y, np.ones_like(x)])
34	    b = x * x + y * y
35	    sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
36	    cx, cy = sol[0] / 2, sol[1] / 2
37	    r = np.sqrt(max(sol[2] + cx * cx + cy * cy, 1e-9))
38	    return float(cx), float(cy), float(r)
39	
40	
41	def surface_line_at_x(mesh: Mesh, x_target: float, j_from: int, j_to: int, stations=None) -> np.ndarray:
42	    """Polyline on the loft surface at constant x, for ring indices j_from..j_to.
43	    Each ring index j is a longitudinal vertex chain; we interpolate along it."""
44	    stations = range(N_STATIONS) if stations is None else stations
45	    out = []
46	    step = 1 if j_to >= j_from else -1
47	    for j in range(j_from, j_to + step, step):
48	        chain = np.array([mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in stations])
49	        xs = chain[:, 0]
50	        k = np.clip(np.searchsorted(xs, x_target) - 1, 0, len(xs) - 2)
51	        t = np.clip((x_target - xs[k]) / max(xs[k + 1] - xs[k], 1e-9), 0, 1)
52	        out.append(chain[k] + (chain[k + 1] - chain[k]) * t)
53	    return np.asarray(out)
54	
55	
56	def aperture_loop(mesh: Mesh, name: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Tuple[int, int], np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
57	    """Ordered vertex loop around a grid aperture + (rows, cols) + outward normal
58	    + the full vertex grid (rows, cols, 3) the aperture was cut from."""
59	    r0, r1, j0, j1 = mesh.meta["aperture_rects"][name]
60	    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
61	    # rows are loft ring rows (already include the fascia offset); convert to station space
62	    r0s, r1s = r0 - off, r1 - off + 1
63	    j1e = j1 + 1
64	    loop = []
65	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j0) for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)]
66	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r1s, j) for j in range(j0 + 1, j1e + 1)]
67	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j1e) for r in range(r1s - 1, r0s - 1, -1)]
68	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r0s, j) for j in range(j1e - 1, j0, -1)]
69	    pts = mesh.vertices[loop]
70	    grid = np.array([[mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, r, j)] for j in range(j0, j1e + 1)] for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)])
71	    faces = mesh.zones[name]
72	    if "_face_normals" not in mesh.meta:
73	        mesh.meta["_face_normals"] = mesh.face_normals()
74	    fn = mesh.meta["_face_normals"][faces].mean(axis=0)
75	    fn /= max(np.linalg.norm(fn), 1e-9)
76	    return pts, (r1s - r0s + 1, j1e - j0 + 1), fn, grid

79	def fascia_point(mesh: Mesh, end: str, z: float, y: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
80	    """Mount on the actual stepped fascia, including the rear plate pocket.
81	
82	    Intersect an X ray with the fascia triangles instead of treating a bumper,
83	    upper panel and recess as one raked plane. All inputs come from the morphed
84	    mesh, so differential targets and style blends move the mounts with it.
85	    """
86	    ids = np.append(mesh.groups[f"fascia/{end}"], mesh.groups[f"apex_{end}"])
87	    mask = np.zeros(mesh.n_vertices, dtype=bool)
88	    mask[ids] = True
89	    tris, _ = mesh.triangulated()
90	    triangles = mesh.vertices[tris[mask[tris].all(axis=1)]]
91	    a, b, c = triangles[:, 0], triangles[:, 1], triangles[:, 2]
92	    u, v = b[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:], c[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:]
93	    q = np.array([y, z]) - a[:, 1:]
94	    det = u[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * v[:, 0]
95	    valid = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
96	    den = np.where(valid, det, 1.0)
97	    s = (q[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - q[:, 1] * v[:, 0]) / den
98	    t = (u[:, 0] * q[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * q[:, 0]) / den
99	    valid &= (s >= -1e-8) & (t >= -1e-8) & (s + t <= 1 + 1e-8)
100	    x = a[:, 0] + s * (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) + t * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
101	    if valid.any():
102	        return np.array([x[valid].max() if end == "front" else x[valid].min(), y, z])
103	    # Out-of-range custom hints still get a finite nearest-surface mount.
104	    pts = mesh.vertices[ids]
105	    nearest = pts[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(pts[:, 1:] - [y, z], axis=1))]
106	    return np.array([nearest[0], y, z])

109	# ------------------------------------------------------------ measurements
110	def measure(mesh: Mesh) -> Dict[str, float]:
111	    V = mesh.vertices
112	    G = mesh.groups
113	
114	    def ring(name):
115	        return V[G[f"ring/{name}"]]
116	
117	    def lring(name):
118	        return V[G[f"lring/{name}"]]
119	
120	    H, E, F, Gj, D, A = J["H"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["D"], J["A"]
121	    cowl, rf, rr, deck = ring("cowl"), ring("roof_front"), ring("roof_rear"), ring("deck")
122	    bp = ring("bp_r")
123	    m: Dict[str, float] = {}
124	    m["x_front"] = float(V[G["fascia/front"]][:, 0].max())
125	    m["x_rear"] = float(V[G["fascia/rear"]][:, 0].min())
126	    m["length"] = m["x_front"] - m["x_rear"]
127	    m["width"] = float(2 * np.abs(V[:, 1]).max())
128	    m["height"] = float(V[:, 2].max())
129	    m["x_cowl"], m["z_cowl"] = float(cowl[H, 0]), float(cowl[H, 2])
130	    m["x_roof_front"], m["z_roof_front"] = float(rf[H, 0]), float(rf[H, 2])
131	    m["x_roof_rear"], m["z_roof_rear"] = float(rr[H, 0]), float(rr[H, 2])
132	    m["x_deck"], m["z_deck"] = float(deck[H, 0]), float(deck[H, 2])
133	    m["x_bpillar"] = float(0.5 * (ring("bp_r")[Gj, 0] + ring("bp_f")[Gj, 0]))
134	    m["roof_half_width"] = float(0.5 * (rf[Gj, 1] + rr[Gj, 1]))
135	    # cabin section at the B pillar
136	    m["z_belt"] = float(bp[E, 2])
137	    m["y_belt"] = float(bp[E, 1])
138	    m["y_shoulder"] = float(bp[F, 1])
139	    m["z_sill"] = float(np.mean([lring("ra_end")[D, 2], lring("fa_start")[D, 2]]))
140	    m["y_sill"] = float(lring("fa_start")[D, 1])
141	    cabin_st = range(station_index("bp_r") - 4, station_index("bp_f") + 4)
142	    m["z_floor"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, A), 2] for i in cabin_st]))
143	    m["y_floor_edge"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, J["B"]), 1] for i in cabin_st]))
144	    # wheels
145	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
146	        pts = V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, [0, 2]]
147	        cx, cz, r = fit_circle(pts)
148	        m[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], m[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], m[f"arch_{tag}_r"] = cx, cz, r
149	        m[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] = float(np.mean(V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, 1]))
150	    m["wheelbase"] = m["wheel_front_x"] - m["wheel_rear_x"]
151	    m["track"] = 2 * m["wheel_front_y"]
152	    # nose / tail faces
153	    nose, tail = V[G["nose_ring"]], V[G["tail_ring"]]
154	    m["nose_z_top"], m["nose_z_bottom"] = float(nose[H, 2]), float(nose[A, 2])
155	    m["nose_half_width"] = float(nose[E, 1])
156	    m["nose_top_half_width"] = float(nose[Gj, 1])
157	    m["tail_z_top"], m["tail_z_bottom"] = float(tail[H, 2]), float(tail[A, 2])
158	    m["tail_half_width"] = float(tail[E, 1])
159	    m["tail_top_half_width"] = float(tail[Gj, 1])
160	    m["bed"] = float(max(0.0, V[G["ring/deck"]][H, 2] - V[vidx(mesh, station_index("deck") // 2, H), 2]))
161	    m["has_bed"] = float(m["bed"] > 0.2)
162	    return m

166	def feature_lines(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], door_count: int = 4) -> List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]]:
167	    V = mesh.vertices
168	    lines: List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
169	    D, E, F, Gj, H = J["D"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["H"]
170	    st = station_index
171	    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
172	
173	    def chain(j, i0, i1):
174	        return np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
175	
176	    def ring_seg(i, j0, j1):
177	        r = ring_pts(mesh, i)
178	        idx = list(range(j0, j1 + 1)) if j1 >= j0 else list(range(j0, j1 - 1, -1))
179	        return r[idx]
180	
181	    for side, mir in (("L", lambda j: j), ("R", mirror_index)):
182	        # hood: side seams along the fender/hood edge, rear seam across the cowl
183	        lines.append((f"hood_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), st("cowl") + 1, st("front") - 3)))
184	        # trunk lid side seams
185	        lines.append((f"deck_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), 3, st("deck"))))
186	        # B pillar seams sill -> roof rail
187	        for nm in ("bp_r", "bp_f"):
188	            lines.append((f"{nm}_seam_{side}", ring_seg(st(nm), mir(D), mir(Gj))))
189	        # front door leading edge: vertical on the door, then along the A pillar aperture edge
190	        x_fd = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
191	        vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_fd, mir(D), mir(E))
192	        pil = ring_seg(st("roof_front"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
193	        lines.append((f"front_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
194	        if door_count >= 4:
195	            x_rd = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
196	            vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_rd, mir(D), mir(E))
197	            pil = ring_seg(st("cp_f"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
198	            lines.append((f"rear_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
199	    # transverse seams (over the top)
200	    lines.append(("hood_rear_seam", ring_seg(st("cowl") + 1, F, mirror_index(F))))
201	    lines.append(("deck_front_seam", ring_seg(st("deck"), F, mirror_index(F))))
202	    # nose & tail hood/trunk front edges
203	    lines.append(("hood_front_seam", ring_seg(st("front") - 3, F, mirror_index(F))))
204	    return lines

207	# --------------------------------------------------------------- connectors
208	def emit_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
209	    """All connectors the body emits.  `hints` carries non-geometric options:
210	    door_count, seat_rows ('auto'|int), drive ('left'|'right'), fuel_side."""
211	    V = mesh.vertices
212	    out: List[Connector] = []
213	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
214	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
215	    ysign_driver = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
216	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
217	
218	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- wheels
219	    tire_w = float(hints.get("tire_width", 0.225))
220	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
221	        cx, cz, r = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], meas[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], meas[f"arch_{tag}_r"]
222	        tire_r = r - float(hints.get("arch_gap", 0.06))
223	        y = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] - tire_w / 2 - 0.01
224	        for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
225	            fr = Frame.from_normal([cx, ys * y, cz], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X)
226	            out.append(CircleConnector(f"wheel_{tag}_{side}", fr, tire_r, tags=["wheel", f"wheel_{tag}"],
227	                                       meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "axle": tag,
228	                                             "tire_width": tire_w, "arch_radius": r, "steer": tag == "front"}))
229	
230	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- apertures
231	    for name in mesh.meta["aperture_rects"]:
232	        pts, grid, nrm, grid_pts = aperture_loop(mesh, name)
233	        short = name.split("/", 1)[1]
234	        kind = "glass" if short.startswith(("glass", "windshield", "rear_window")) else "light"
235	        tags = [kind, short.rstrip("_LR").rstrip("_")]
236	        if short.startswith("headlight"):
237	            tags.append("headlight")
238	        if short.startswith("taillight"):
239	            tags.append("taillight")
240	        side = "left" if short.endswith("_L") else "right" if short.endswith("_R") else "center"
241	        x_hint = Y if kind == "glass" else X
242	        conn = PolygonConnector.from_points(name.replace("aperture/", ""), pts, normal_hint=nrm, x_hint=x_hint,
243	                                            tags=tags, meta={"grid": list(grid), "grid_points": grid_pts, "side": side, "aperture": True})
244	        out.append(conn)
245	
246	    # --------------------------------------------------------- exterior bits
247	    nose = V[mesh.groups["nose_ring"]]
248	    tail = V[mesh.groups["tail_ring"]]
249	    apex_f = V[mesh.groups["apex_front"]][0]
250	    apex_r = V[mesh.groups["apex_rear"]][0]
251	    nose_n, tail_n = X, -X
252	    z_nose_top, z_nose_bot = meas["nose_z_top"], meas["nose_z_bottom"]
253	    z_tail_top, z_tail_bot = meas["tail_z_top"], meas["tail_z_bottom"]
254	    nose_w = 2 * meas["nose_top_half_width"]
255	    tail_w = 2 * meas["tail_top_half_width"]
256	
257	    def on_face(apex, nrm, z, ahead=0.004, y=0.0):
258	        end = "front" if nrm[0] > 0 else "rear"
259	        return fascia_point(mesh, end, z, y) + nrm * ahead
260	
261	    grille_z = z_nose_top - 0.18
262	    out.append(RectangleConnector("grille", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
263	                                  min(nose_w * 0.62, 1.1), 0.17, tags=["grille"], meta={"style_hint": hints.get("style", "sedan")}))
264	    intake_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16
265	    out.append(RectangleConnector("intake", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, intake_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
266	                                  min(nose_w * 0.8, 1.2), 0.14, tags=["grille", "intake"], meta={"lower": True}))
267	    plate_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16 + 0.15
268	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, (grille_z + intake_z) / 2 - 0.02, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
269	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "front"}))
270	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.5 * (z_tail_top - z_tail_bot), 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y),
271	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
272	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z + 0.11, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y), tags=["badge"]))
273	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_top - 0.16, 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y), tags=["badge"]))
274	    # exhaust tips
275	    for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
276	        p = on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.10, 0.0,
277	                    y=ys * (meas["tail_half_width"] - 0.32))
278	        out.append(CircleConnector(f"exhaust_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, tail_n, x_hint=Y), 0.038, tags=["exhaust"],
279	                                   meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
280	    # side mirrors at the front-bottom corner of the front door glass
281	    st = station_index
282	    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
283	        p = V[vidx(mesh, st("roof_front"), mir(J["F"]))].copy()
284	        p[0] += 0.02
285	        p[2] += 0.02
286	        out.append(PointConnector(f"mirror_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, [0.0, ys, 0.0], x_hint=X), tags=["mirror"],
287	                                  meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
288	        # door handles: on the door skin just below the belt, mid-door
289	        x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
290	        x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
291	        for door, x0, x1, ok in (("front", x_fd0, x_fd1, True),
292	                                 ("rear", x_fd1, meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02, door_count >= 4)):
293	            if not ok:
294	                continue
295	            xh = x1 + 0.62 * (x0 - x1)
296	            zh = meas["z_belt"] - 0.11
297	            line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xh, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
298	            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zh)))
299	            p = line[k].copy()
300	            nrm = np.array([0.0, ys, 0.0])
301	            out.append(PointConnector(f"handle_{door}_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, nrm, x_hint=X), tags=["handle"],
302	                                      meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door}))
303	        # roof rails along the roof edge (upper chain is numbered rear -> front)
304	        i0, i1 = st("roof_rear") + 1, st("roof_front") - 1
305	        if i1 > i0 + 1:
306	            pts = np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, mir(J["G"]))] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
307	            length = float(pts[-1, 0] - pts[0, 0])
308	            c = pts.mean(axis=0)
309	            fr = Frame.from_normal(c, Z, x_hint=X)
310	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"roof_rail_{side}", fr, abs(length), 0.05, tags=["roof_rail"],
311	                                          meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "path": pts}))
312	    # fuel cap on the rear quarter (fuel side from hints)
313	    fs = hints.get("fuel_side", "left")
314	    ys = 1.0 if fs == "left" else -1.0
315	    mir = (lambda j: j) if ys > 0 else mirror_index
316	    xf = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + 0.08
317	    line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xf, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
318	    zf = meas["z_belt"] - 0.20
319	    k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zf)))
320	    out.append(CircleConnector("fuel_cap", Frame.from_normal(line[k], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X), 0.065, tags=["fuel_cap"],
321	                               meta={"side": fs}))
322	    # antenna / shark fin near the rear of the roof
323	    i_ant = st("roof_rear") + 1
324	    p = V[vidx(mesh, i_ant, J["H"])]
325	    out.append(PointConnector("antenna", Frame.from_normal(p, Z, x_hint=X), tags=["antenna"]))
326	
327	    # -------------------------------------------------------------- interior
328	    out += interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
329	    from .connectors_extra import extra_exterior_connectors
330	    out += extra_exterior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
331	    return out

334	def _face_normal_from_ring(ring: np.ndarray, sign: float) -> np.ndarray:
335	    top = ring[J["H"]]
336	    bot = ring[J["A"]]
337	    d = top - bot  # face direction (mostly vertical, tilted by the rake)
338	    n = np.array([d[2], 0.0, -d[0]])
339	    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
340	    if np.sign(n[0]) != np.sign(sign):
341	        n = -n
342	    return n

345	def interior_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
346	    V = mesh.vertices
347	    out: List[Connector] = []
348	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
349	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
350	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
351	    ysd = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
352	    st = station_index
353	
354	    floor = meas["z_floor"] + 0.05             # cabin floor (carpet top)
355	    inner_half = meas["y_shoulder"] - 0.08     # cabin inner half width at the belt
356	    roof_h = meas["z_roof_front"]
357	    h_point = float(hints.get("h_point_height", np.clip(0.17 + (roof_h - 1.2) * 0.4, 0.17, 0.38)))
358	    x_h1 = meas["x_cowl"] - float(hints.get("front_h_point_offset", 0.95))
359	    z_h1 = floor + h_point
360	    y_seat = min(0.42, inner_half - 0.36)
361	    x_firewall = meas["x_cowl"] + 0.12
362	    has_bed = meas.get("has_bed", 0.0) > 0.5
363	    x_cab_rear = min(meas["x_roof_rear"] - 0.05, meas["x_deck"] + 0.55) if not has_bed else meas["x_deck"] - 0.05
364	    x_cab_rear = min(x_cab_rear, meas["x_roof_rear"] + 0.15)
365	    # seat rows -----------------------------------------------------------------
366	    rows_cfg = hints.get("seat_rows", "auto")
367	    pitch = 0.86
368	    row_x = [x_h1]
369	    while len(row_x) < 3 and row_x[-1] - pitch - 0.30 > x_cab_rear - 0.12:
370	        row_x.append(row_x[-1] - pitch)
371	    if rows_cfg != "auto":
372	        rows_cfg = int(rows_cfg)
373	        row_x = [x_h1 - k * pitch for k in range(max(1, rows_cfg))]
374	    n_rows = len(row_x)
375	    seat_w, seat_d = 0.52, 0.55
376	    for r, xh in enumerate(row_x):
377	        if r == 0:
378	            for name, ys in (("driver", ysd), ("passenger", -ysd)):
379	                fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.12, ys * y_seat, floor], Z, x_hint=X)
380	                out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_front_{name}", fr, seat_d, seat_w, tags=["seat", "seat_front"],
381	                                              meta={"row": 0, "role": name, "h_point_height": h_point,
382	                                                    "headroom": roof_h - 0.03 - floor, "side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
383	        else:
384	            bench_w = 2 * inner_half - 0.12
385	            room = row_x[r - 1] - xh
386	            fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.10, 0.0, floor + (0.02 if r == 1 else 0.0)], Z, x_hint=X)
387	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_row{r + 1}", fr, seat_d - 0.05, bench_w, tags=["seat", "seat_bench", f"seat_row{r + 1}"],
388	                                          meta={"row": r, "role": "bench", "h_point_height": h_point - 0.02 * r,
389	                                                "headroom": meas["z_roof_rear"] - 0.03 - floor if r == n_rows - 1 else roof_h - floor,
390	                                                "legroom": room}))
391	    # steering wheel / column ---------------------------------------------------
392	    col_angle = np.radians(float(hints.get("column_angle", 24.0)))
393	    wheel_c = np.array([x_h1 + 0.52, ysd * y_seat, z_h1 + 0.32])
394	    n = np.array([-np.cos(col_angle), 0.0, np.sin(col_angle)])
395	    out.append(CircleConnector("steering_wheel", Frame.from_normal(wheel_c, n, x_hint=Y), 0.185, tags=["steering_wheel"],
396	                               meta={"column_angle_deg": float(np.degrees(col_angle)), "column_length": 0.35}))
397	    # dashboard: interior section just behind the windshield base ----------------
398	    cowl = ring_pts(mesh, st("cowl"))
399	    yE = cowl[J["E"], 1] - 0.09
400	    z_top = meas["z_cowl"] - 0.03
401	    z_lo = floor + 0.32
402	    x_dash = meas["x_cowl"] - 0.02
403	    dash_pts = np.array([
404	        [x_dash, -yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_top - 0.12], [x_dash, yE - 0.10, z_top],
405	        [x_dash, -yE + 0.10, z_top], [x_dash, -yE, z_top - 0.12],
406	    ])
407	    dash = PolygonConnector.from_points("dashboard", dash_pts, normal_hint=-X, x_hint=-Y, tags=["dashboard"],
408	                                        meta={"driver_y": ysd * y_seat, "depth": 0.55, "floor": floor,
409	                                              "windshield_x": meas["x_cowl"], "steering_center": wheel_c})
410	    out.append(dash)
411	    # pedals ------------------------------------------------------------------------
412	    out.append(RectangleConnector("pedals", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.86, ysd * y_seat, floor + 0.02], Z, x_hint=X),
413	                                  0.20, 0.34, tags=["pedals"], meta={"transmission": hints.get("transmission", "automatic")}))
414	    # centre console between the front seats --------------------------------------
415	    console_len = 0.95
416	    out.append(RectangleConnector("console", Frame.from_normal([x_h1 + 0.18, 0.0, floor], Z, x_hint=X), console_len, 0.26,
417	                                  tags=["console"], meta={"height": z_h1 - floor + 0.06, "driver_y": ysd * y_seat}))
418	    # cabin floor --------------------------------------------------------------------
419	    fl_len = x_firewall - x_cab_rear
420	    out.append(RectangleConnector("floor", Frame.from_normal([(x_firewall + x_cab_rear) / 2, 0.0, floor - 0.01], Z, x_hint=X),
421	                                  fl_len, 2 * inner_half + 0.10, tags=["floor"], meta={"tunnel_height": 0.16, "seat_rows": n_rows}))
422	    # firewall / bulkheads (simple rectangles so the cabin reads as enclosed)
423	    out.append(RectangleConnector("firewall", Frame.from_normal([x_firewall, 0.0, (floor + z_lo) / 2], -X, x_hint=-Y),
424	                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, z_lo - floor + 0.02, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "front"}))
425	    out.append(RectangleConnector("rear_bulkhead", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear, 0.0, (floor + meas["z_belt"]) / 2], X, x_hint=Y),
426	                                  2 * inner_half + 0.10, meas["z_belt"] - floor, tags=["bulkhead"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
427	    # parcel shelf (sedan) or cargo floor (hatch/wagon)
428	    if meas["x_deck"] < x_cab_rear - 0.2 and not has_bed:
429	        length = x_cab_rear - meas["x_deck"]
430	        out.append(RectangleConnector("parcel_shelf", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - length / 2, 0.0, meas["z_deck"] - 0.10], Z, x_hint=X),
431	                                      length, 2 * inner_half + 0.05, tags=["shelf"]))
432	        # trunk floor
433	        tl = length + 0.2
434	        out.append(RectangleConnector("trunk_floor", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - tl / 2 - 0.05, 0.0, floor + 0.10], Z, x_hint=X),
435	                                      tl, 2 * inner_half - 0.1, tags=["cargo_floor"], meta={"enclosed": True}))
436	    elif not has_bed:
437	        length = x_cab_rear - (meas["x_rear"] + 0.25)
438	        if length > 0.3:
439	            out.append(RectangleConnector("cargo_floor", Frame.from_normal([x_cab_rear - length / 2, 0.0, floor + 0.12], Z, x_hint=X),
440	                                          length, 2 * inner_half - 0.05, tags=["cargo_floor"], meta={"enclosed": False}))
441	    # headliner: interior side of the roof (stations run rear -> front) --------------------
442	    i0, i1 = st("roof_rear"), st("roof_front")
443	    jG, jH = J["G"], J["H"]
444	    loop = []
445	    loop += [vidx(mesh, i, jG) for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)]
446	    loop += [vidx(mesh, i1, j) for j in range(jG + 1, mirror_index(jG) + 1)]
447	    loop += [vidx(mesh, i, mirror_index(jG)) for i in range(i1 - 1, i0 - 1, -1)]
448	    loop += [vidx(mesh, i0, j) for j in range(mirror_index(jG) - 1, jG, -1)]
449	    pts = V[loop].copy()
450	    pts[:, 2] -= 0.035
451	    hl_grid = np.array([[V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for j in range(jG, mirror_index(jG) + 1)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
452	    hl_grid[:, :, 2] -= 0.035
453	    out.append(PolygonConnector.from_points("headliner", pts, normal_hint=-Z, x_hint=X, tags=["headliner"],
454	                                            meta={"grid": [i1 - i0 + 1, mirror_index(jG) - jG + 1], "grid_points": hl_grid,
455	                                                  "roof_center_x": (meas["x_roof_front"] + meas["x_roof_rear"]) / 2}))
456	    # rear-view mirror
457	    p = V[vidx(mesh, i0 + 1, jH)].copy()
458	    p[2] -= 0.12
459	    out.append(PointConnector("rearview_mirror", Frame.from_normal(p, -X, x_hint=Y), tags=["rearview_mirror"]))
460	    # door cards: interior side of each door ---------------------------------------------
461	    x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
462	    x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
463	    x_rd1 = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
464	    doors = [("front", x_fd0, x_fd1)]
465	    if door_count >= 4:
466	        doors.append(("rear", x_fd1, x_rd1))
467	    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
468	        for door, xa, xb in doors:
469	            ja, jb = mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"])
470	            front = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xa, ja, jb)
471	            rear = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xb, ja, jb)
472	            n_len = 6
473	            poly = []
474	            # bottom edge (along the sill) from front to rear, rear edge up, top edge back, front edge down
475	            for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n_len, endpoint=False):
476	                poly.append(front[0] + (rear[0] - front[0]) * t)
477	            poly += list(rear)
478	            for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n_len, endpoint=False)[1:]:
479	                poly.append(rear[-1] + (front[-1] - rear[-1]) * t)
480	            poly += list(front[::-1][:-1])
481	            poly = np.asarray(poly)
482	            poly[:, 1] -= ys * 0.09
483	            poly[:, 2] += 0.02
484	            out.append(PolygonConnector.from_points(f"door_card_{door}_{side}", poly, normal_hint=[0, -ys, 0], x_hint=X,
485	                                                    tags=["door_card"], meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door,
486	                                                                              "grid": [n_len + 1, len(front)], "belt_z": float(meas["z_belt"])}))
487	    # pickup bed floor connector
488	    if has_bed:
489	        deck_r = ring_pts(mesh, st("deck"))
490	        length = meas["x_deck"] - meas["x_rear"] - 0.1
491	        out.append(RectangleConnector("bed_floor", Frame.from_normal([meas["x_rear"] + 0.05 + length / 2, 0.0, meas["z_deck"] - meas["bed"] + 0.01], Z, x_hint=X),
492	                                      length, 2 * (meas["roof_half_width"] - 0.05), tags=["cargo_floor", "bed"], meta={"enclosed": False}))
493	    from .connectors_extra import extra_interior_connectors
494	    out += extra_interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
495	    return out

2	
3	Three kinds of targets are used:
4	
5	* **differential targets** – one bipolar modifier per generator parameter,
6	  computed by re-running the fixed-topology generator with the parameter moved
7	  by a physically meaningful amount (e.g. wheelbase ± 0.4 m);
8	* **macro targets** – one unipolar modifier per body style (hatchback, wagon,
9	  suv, ...) computed as `generate(style) - generate(sedan)`;
10	* **sculpt targets** – hand-authored procedural displacement fields that are not
11	  expressible through the generator parameters (rear haunches, side crease,
12	  wedge stance, roof bubble).

91	def _side_weight(base: Mesh):
92	    """Signed lateral direction (+1 left side, -1 right side, 0 centre) per vertex."""
93	    y = base.vertices[:, 1]
94	    return np.sign(y) * np.clip(np.abs(y) / 0.3, 0, 1)
95	
96	
97	def sculpt_haunches(base: Mesh, params: BodyParams) -> Target:
98	    """Muscular bulge over the rear wheel arches (like a Coke-bottle shoulder)."""
99	    v = base.vertices
100	    L = params.layout()
101	    xr = L["x_ra"]
102	    side = _side_weight(base)
103	    ax = np.exp(-((v[:, 0] - xr - 0.1) / 0.55) ** 2)
104	    az = smoothstep(params.sill_height + 0.1, params.belt_height - 0.15, v[:, 2]) * (1 - smoothstep(params.belt_height + 0.02, params.belt_height + 0.2, v[:, 2]))
105	    amp = 0.05 * ax * az * side
106	    off = np.zeros_like(v)
107	    off[:, 1] = amp
108	    return Target("sculpt-haunches", off, "rear fender muscle bulge")
109	
110	
111	def sculpt_side_crease(base: Mesh, params: BodyParams) -> Target:
112	    """A sharp character line just below the belt (pushes the skin out above it, in below)."""
113	    v = base.vertices
114	    side = _side_weight(base)
115	    zc = params.belt_height - 0.12
116	    d = v[:, 2] - zc
117	    prof = np.where(d > 0, np.exp(-(d / 0.05) ** 2), -0.6 * np.exp(-(d / 0.08) ** 2))
118	    L = params.layout()
119	    ax = smoothstep(L["x_rear"] + 0.4, L["x_rear"] + 0.9, v[:, 0]) * (1 - smoothstep(L["x_front"] - 0.9, L["x_front"] - 0.4, v[:, 0]))
120	    off = np.zeros_like(v)
121	    off[:, 1] = 0.02 * prof * side * ax
122	    return Target("sculpt-side_crease", off, "character crease below the belt line")
123	
124	
125	def sculpt_wedge(base: Mesh, params: BodyParams) -> Target:
126	    """Wedge stance: nose down, tail up (rotation about the lateral axis)."""
127	    v = base.vertices
128	    ang = np.radians(1.6)
129	    dz = -np.sin(ang) * v[:, 0]
130	    # keep the wheel arches at the same height by counter-lifting the underbody
131	    off = np.zeros_like(v)
132	    off[:, 2] = dz * smoothstep(params.ground_clearance + 0.15, params.sill_height + 0.2, v[:, 2])
133	    return Target("sculpt-wedge", off, "nose-down wedge stance")
134	
135	
136	def sculpt_roof_bubble(base: Mesh, params: BodyParams) -> Target:
137	    v = base.vertices
138	    L = params.layout()
139	    xc = 0.5 * (L["u_roof_front"] + L["u_roof_rear"])
140	    ax = np.exp(-((v[:, 0] - xc) / 0.7) ** 2)
141	    az = smoothstep(params.roof_height - 0.25, params.roof_height - 0.03, v[:, 2])
142	    off = np.zeros_like(v)
143	    off[:, 2] = 0.06 * ax * az
144	    return Target("sculpt-roof_bubble", off, "raised roof bubble")

171	def _cache_key(params: BodyParams) -> str:
172	    import hashlib, json
173	    from .generator import SEGMENTS, UPPER_COUNTS, LOWER_COUNTS
174	    payload = json.dumps([LIBRARY_VERSION, params.to_dict(), SEGMENTS, UPPER_COUNTS, LOWER_COUNTS,

180	def _save_library(mm: MorphableMesh, path):
181	    arrays = {}
182	    for name, t in mm.targets.items():
183	        arrays[f"t:{name}"] = t.offsets.astype(np.float32)
184	    np.savez_compressed(path, **arrays)

187	def _load_library(mm_skeleton: MorphableMesh, path) -> bool:
188	    try:
189	        data = np.load(path)
190	    except Exception:
191	        return False
192	    for name, t in mm_skeleton.targets.items():
193	        key = f"t:{name}"
194	        if key not in data or data[key].shape != t.offsets.shape:
195	            return False
196	        t.offsets = data[key].astype(float)
197	    return True

200	def _skeleton(params: BodyParams) -> MorphableMesh:
201	    """Modifier structure with zero targets (filled from cache or by generation)."""
202	    base = _generate(params)
203	    mm = MorphableMesh(base, "car_body")
204	    zeros = np.zeros_like(base.vertices)
205	    for spec in BODY_MODIFIER_SPECS:
206	        name = spec.name or spec.param
207	        incr = Target(f"{name}-incr", zeros.copy()) if spec.delta_plus else None
208	        decr = Target(f"{name}-decr", zeros.copy()) if spec.delta_minus else None
209	        mm.add_modifier(Modifier(name, incr, decr, -1.0 if decr is not None else 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, spec.group,
210	                                 spec.description, unit_scale=spec.delta_plus))
211	    for style in STYLE_OVERRIDES:
212	        if style == "sedan":
213	            continue
214	        mm.add_modifier(Modifier(f"style/{style}", Target(f"style-{style}", zeros.copy()), None, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, "style", f"macro target: {style}"))
215	    for name in SCULPTS:
216	        mm.add_modifier(Modifier(f"sculpt/{name}", Target(f"sculpt-{name}", zeros.copy()), None, -1.0, 1.0, 0.0, "sculpt", name))
217	    return mm

220	@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
221	def _cached_library(params_key: tuple) -> MorphableMesh:
222	    params = BodyParams(**dict(params_key))
223	    cache_file = _cache_dir() / f"body_targets_{_cache_key(params)}.npz"
224	    skel = _skeleton(params)
225	    if cache_file.exists() and _load_library(skel, cache_file):
226	        return skel
227	    builder = DifferentialTargetBuilder(_generate, params, name="car_body")
228	    macros = {name: style_params(name, params) for name in STYLE_OVERRIDES if name != "sedan"}
229	    mm = builder.build(BODY_MODIFIER_SPECS, macros=macros, macro_group="style")
230	    for name, fn in SCULPTS.items():
231	        t = fn(mm.base, params)
232	        mm.add_modifier(Modifier(f"sculpt/{name}", t, None, -1.0, 1.0, 0.0, "sculpt", t.description))
233	    try:
234	        _save_library(mm, cache_file)
235	    except OSError:
236	        pass
237	    return mm

240	def body_library(params: BodyParams | None = None) -> MorphableMesh:
241	    """Morphable body for the given base parameters (cached)."""
242	    params = params or BodyParams()
243	    key = tuple(sorted(params.to_dict().items()))
244	    return _cached_library(key)

1	"""Canonical parameters of the body generator.
2	
3	All lengths in metres.  The canonical values describe a mid-size sedan; the
4	style presets in `styles.py` are full parameter sets for other body types and
5	become *macro targets* (like MakeHuman's gender/age/weight macros).
6	
7	Coordinate conventions: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, ground at Z=0, origin at
8	the middle of the wheelbase.
9	"""
10	from __future__ import annotations
11	
12	from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, fields
13	import math
14	
15	
16	@dataclass
17	class BodyParams:
18	    # ---- overall proportions -------------------------------------------------
19	    wheelbase: float = 2.75
20	    front_overhang: float = 0.95
21	    rear_overhang: float = 1.05
22	    width: float = 1.84            # maximum body width (at the belt line)
23	    ground_clearance: float = 0.15
24	    # ---- wheels / arches -----------------------------------------------------
25	    wheel_diameter: float = 0.66
26	    tire_width: float = 0.225
27	    arch_gap: float = 0.06         # radial gap between tyre and arch lip
28	    fender_flare: float = 0.025    # outward bulge of the arch lip
29	    arch_lip_width: float = 0.020  # radial width of the folded arch flange
30	    # ---- lower body ----------------------------------------------------------
31	    sill_height: float = 0.36      # top of the rocker panel
32	    sill_inset: float = 0.05       # rocker sits this far inboard of the belt line
33	    rocker_height: float = 0.15   # flat, vertical sill face
34	    door_step: float = 0.012      # door hem proud of the rocker
35	    tunnel_height: float = 0.065  # longitudinal floor-pan tunnel (up into cabin)
36	    tunnel_width: float = 0.28    # full width, including tunnel shoulders
37	    air_dam_height: float = 0.035 # front skirt below the painted bumper
38	    rear_valance_height: float = 0.045  # rear skirt below the bumper

+def fascia_point(mesh: Mesh, end: str, z: float, y: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Mount on the actual stepped fascia, including the rear plate pocket.
+
+    Intersect an X ray with the fascia triangles instead of treating a bumper,
+    upper panel and recess as one raked plane. All inputs come from the morphed
+    mesh, so differential targets and style blends move the mounts with it.
+    """
+    ids = np.append(mesh.groups[f"fascia/{end}"], mesh.groups[f"apex_{end}"])
+    mask = np.zeros(mesh.n_vertices, dtype=bool)
+    mask[ids] = True
+    tris, _ = mesh.triangulated()
+    triangles = mesh.vertices[tris[mask[tris].all(axis=1)]]
+    a, b, c = triangles[:, 0], triangles[:, 1], triangles[:, 2]
+    u, v = b[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:], c[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:]
+    q = np.array([y, z]) - a[:, 1:]
+    det = u[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * v[:, 0]
+    valid = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
+    den = np.where(valid, det, 1.0)
+    s = (q[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - q[:, 1] * v[:, 0]) / den
+    t = (u[:, 0] * q[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * q[:, 0]) / den
+    valid &= (s >= -1e-8) & (t >= -1e-8) & (s + t <= 1 + 1e-8)
+    x = a[:, 0] + s * (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) + t * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
+    if valid.any():
+        return np.array([x[valid].max() if end == "front" else x[valid].min(), y, z])
+    # Out-of-range custom hints still get a finite nearest-surface mount.
+    pts = mesh.vertices[ids]
+    nearest = pts[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(pts[:, 1:] - [y, z], axis=1))]
+    return np.array([nearest[0], y, z])
