517	    # ------------------------------------------------------------ details
518	    def _apply_rake(self, rings: List[np.ndarray]) -> List[np.ndarray]:
519	        """Keep the bumper upright; rake only the upper nose and tail panels.
520	
521	        The nominal ends include the bumper/lip, not an extra cap extension.
522	        Arch vertices are untouched because their stations are outside the corner.
523	        """
524	        p, L = self.p, self.L
525	        out = []
526	        for i, ring in enumerate(rings):
527	            r = ring.copy()
528	            # Each vertex follows its own longitudinal chain (important at arches).
529	            for forward, end, run in ((True, L["x_front"], p.front_corner_length),
530	                                      (False, L["x_rear"], p.rear_corner_length)):
531	                sign = 1 if forward else -1
532	                w = np.clip(1 - sign * (end - r[:, 0]) / max(run, 1e-6), 0, 1) ** 2
533	                reserve = p.bumper_projection + (p.front_splitter if forward else 0.0)
534	                r[:, 0] -= sign * reserve * w
535	                crease = p.bumper_crease_height if forward else p.rear_bumper_crease_height
536	                top = p.hood_front_height if forward else p.deck_rear_height
537	                rake = p.front_fascia_rake if forward else -p.rear_fascia_rake
538	                upper = np.clip((r[:, 2] - crease) / max(top - crease, 0.08), 0, 1)
539	                r[:, 0] -= sign * rake * w * upper
540	            out.append(r)
541	        return out
542	
543	    def _fascia_x(self, y, z, forward: bool):
544	        """Piecewise bumper section: lip, upright face, upper setback, hood lip."""
545	        p, L = self.p, self.L
546	        if forward:
547	            bottom, top, crease = p.front_bumper_bottom, p.hood_front_height, p.bumper_crease_height
548	            # A narrow crease, not a rake through the entire bumper volume.
549	            upper = smoothstep(crease, crease + 0.025, z)
550	            hood = smoothstep(top - 0.035, top - 0.008, z)
551	            lip = 1 - smoothstep(bottom + 0.012, bottom + 0.045, z)
552	            return (L["x_front"] - p.front_splitter + p.front_splitter * lip
553	                    - (p.front_fascia_rake + p.hood_overhang) * upper + p.hood_overhang * hood)
554	        bottom, crease = p.rear_bumper_bottom, p.rear_bumper_crease_height
555	        valance = 1 - smoothstep(bottom + 0.04, bottom + 0.10, z)
556	        panel = smoothstep(crease, crease + 0.035, z)
557	        return (L["x_rear"] + p.diffuser_step * valance
558	                + (p.tailgate_panel - p.rear_fascia_rake) * panel)
559	
560	    def _fascia(self, ring: np.ndarray, forward: bool) -> Tuple[List[np.ndarray], np.ndarray]:
561	        """Rounded bumper perimeter closing onto a *flat* rectangular pocket.
562	
563	        The final fan is coplanar with the pocket floor: its apex is a useful
564	        centre landmark, not a pointed nose.  Corresponding rings exist even
565	        when a recess or splitter has zero depth, preserving target topology.
566	        """
567	        p = self.p
568	        bottom = (p.front_bumper_bottom - p.air_dam_height if forward
569	                  else p.rear_bumper_bottom - p.rear_valance_height)
570	        top = p.hood_front_height if forward else p.deck_rear_height
571	        crease = p.bumper_crease_height if forward else p.rear_bumper_crease_height
572	        hw = max(abs(ring[:, 1]))
573	        zmid = (bottom + top) / 2
574	
575	        def outline(width, lo, hi, shoulder):
576	            # Semantic samples retain the lamp corner (D..G) and flat top/bottom.
577	            radius = min(0.045, width * 0.12, (hi - lo) * 0.18)
578	            pts = np.array([(0, lo), (width - radius, lo), (width, lo + radius),
579	                            (width, lo + 2 * radius), (width, np.clip(shoulder, lo + 2.5 * radius, hi - radius)),
580	                            (width - radius * 0.3, hi - radius * 0.3), (width - radius, hi),
581	                            (width * 2 / 3, hi), (width / 3, hi), (0, hi)])
582	            full = np.vstack([pts, pts[1:-1][::-1] * [-1, 1]])
583	            counts = [n for _, _, n in SEGMENTS]
584	            return catmull_rom_closed(full, counts + counts[::-1], np.ones(len(full)))
585	
586	        face_yz = outline(hw * 0.985, bottom, top, crease)
587	        face = np.column_stack([self._fascia_x(face_yz[:, 0], face_yz[:, 1], forward), face_yz])
588	        # The first roll carries wraparound lamps into the face. The next roll
589	        # gives the bumper a rounded edge without a pillow-shaped central cap.
590	        corner = ring.copy()
591	        corner[:, 1] *= 0.995
592	        corner[:, 2] = zmid + (corner[:, 2] - zmid) * 0.995
593	        corner[:, 0] += (1 if forward else -1) * p.bumper_projection * 0.55
594	        out = [corner, face]
595	        for k, (width, lo, hi, depth) in enumerate((
596	                (hw * 0.87, bottom + 0.035, top - 0.025, 0.0),
597	                (0.32, zmid - 0.115, zmid + 0.115, 0.0),
598	                (0.29, zmid - 0.09, zmid + 0.09, p.plate_recess),
599	                (0.20, zmid - 0.06, zmid + 0.06, p.plate_recess))):
600	            if forward and k > 0:
601	                # Full-width upper grille landing, then the bumper crease.
602	                # No artificial licence-plate-shaped dent in the front face.
603	                width = hw * (0.80, 0.77, 0.46)[k - 1]
604	                lo = bottom + (0.07, 0.09, 0.13)[k - 1]
605	                hi = min(top - 0.04, crease + (0.025, 0.0, -0.025)[k - 1])
606	                hi = max(lo + 0.02, hi)
607	            yz = outline(width, lo, hi, crease if k == 0 else zmid)
608	            x = self._fascia_x(yz[:, 0], yz[:, 1], forward)
609	            if not forward and k >= 1:
610	                x = np.full(len(yz), self.L["x_rear"] + depth)
611	            out.append(np.column_stack([x, yz]))
612	        if forward:
613	            zmid = float((out[-1][:, 2].min() + out[-1][:, 2].max()) / 2)
614	        apex_x = float(self._fascia_x(0.0, zmid, forward)) if forward else self.L["x_rear"] + p.plate_recess
615	        return out, np.array([apex_x, 0.0, zmid])

617	    def _assign_zones(self, mesh: Mesh, face_grid, off: int):
618	        """Classify faces into zones (apertures, underbody, trim)."""
619	        p, L = self.p, self.L
620	        u = lambda name: station_index(name, "upper") + off  # noqa: E731
621	        l = lambda name: station_index(name, "lower") + off  # noqa: E731
622	        zones: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
623	        rects: Dict[str, Tuple[int, int, int, int]] = {}
624	
625	        def add(zone, rows, cols):
626	            rows, cols = list(rows), list(cols)
627	            for r in rows:
628	                for j in cols:
629	                    fi = face_grid.get((r, j))
630	                    if fi is not None:
631	                        zones.setdefault(zone, []).append(fi)
632	            if rows and cols:
633	                rects[zone] = (min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols))
634	
635	        jF, jG, jH, jE, jD, jC = RING["F"], RING["G"], RING["H"], RING["E"], RING["D"], RING["C"]
636	        for name, (rows, cols) in self._glass_regions().items():
637	            add(name, range(rows.start + off, rows.stop + off), cols)
638	        # lights: wrap-around corner strips at the nose/tail
639	        n_front = 3
640	        n_rear = 3
641	        jL = jE - 3  # lights extend down the fender side to mid height of the D->E strip
642	        # End at the fender fold: glass/light fills must not bridge the folded
643	        # hood seam, whose return face intentionally has an opposing normal.
644	        add("aperture/headlight_L", range(u("front") - n_front, u("front") + 1), range(jL, jF))
645	        add("aperture/headlight_R", range(u("front") - n_front, u("front") + 1), range(RING_N - jF, RING_N - jL))
646	        add("aperture/taillight_L", range(off - 1, off + n_rear), range(jL, jF))
647	        add("aperture/taillight_R", range(off - 1, off + n_rear), range(RING_N - jF, RING_N - jL))
648	        # underbody / wells
649	        all_rows = range(off, off + N_STATIONS - 1)
650	        add("underbody", all_rows, list(range(0, jC)) + list(range(RING_N - jC, RING_N)))
651	        arch_rows = [i + off for i in range(N_STATIONS) if self.arch(self.x_lo[i])[0] > 0]
652	        add("wheel_well", arch_rows, list(range(jC, jD)) + list(range(RING_N - jD, RING_N - jC)))
653	        # Only the outer skirt bands are dark. Ring columns on an inner
654	        # fascia encircle the plate, so calling them "underbody" would paint
655	        # triangular wedges halfway up the bumper.
656	        skirt_rows = list(range(off - 3, off)) + list(range(off + N_STATIONS - 1, off + N_STATIONS + 2))
657	        add("trim", skirt_rows, list(range(0, RING["C"])) + list(range(RING_N - RING["C"], RING_N)))
658	        if self.bed is not None:
659	            bed_rows = [i + off for i in range(N_STATIONS) if self.bed(self.x_hi[i]) > 0.5]
660	            add("bed", bed_rows, range(RING["G2"], RING_N - RING["G2"]))
661	        for name, idx in zones.items():
662	            mesh.add_zone(name, idx)
663	            if name.startswith("aperture/"):
664	                mesh.set_material(GLASS_ZONE, idx)
665	            elif name in ("underbody", "wheel_well"):
666	                mesh.set_material(UNDERBODY, idx)
667	            elif name == "trim":
668	                mesh.set_material(TRIM, idx)
669	            elif name == "bed":
670	                mesh.set_material("bed", idx)
671	        mesh.meta["aperture_rects"] = {k: v for k, v in rects.items() if k.startswith("aperture/")}
672	        mesh.meta["arch_rows"] = [int(r) for r in arch_rows]

674	    def _assign_groups(self, mesh: Mesh, off: int, n_rings: int, rear_apex_i: int, front_apex_i: int):
675	        """Vertex groups / landmarks that connectors are derived from."""
676	        L = self.L
677	
678	        def v(ring_i, j):
679	            return (ring_i + off) * RING_N + j
680	
681	        def ring_group(name, ring_i, js):
682	            mesh.add_group(name, [v(ring_i, j) for j in js])
683	
684	        half_left = range(0, HALF_N + 1)
685	        for nm in UPPER_NAMES:
686	            i = station_index(nm, "upper")
687	            ring_group(f"ring/{nm}", i, range(RING_N))
688	        for nm in LOWER_NAMES:
689	            i = station_index(nm, "lower")
690	            ring_group(f"lring/{nm}", i, range(RING_N))
691	        # arch lips (D points) for circle fitting
692	        for tag, a, b in (("front", "fa_start", "fa_end"), ("rear", "ra_start", "ra_end")):
693	            i0, i1 = station_index(a, "lower"), station_index(b, "lower")
694	            mesh.add_group(f"arch_{tag}_L", [v(i, RING["D"]) for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
695	            mesh.add_group(f"arch_{tag}_R", [v(i, mirror_index(RING["D"])) for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
696	        # longitudinal feature lines
697	        for key, j in (("floor", RING["A"]), ("sill_L", RING["D"]), ("belt_L", RING["E"]), ("shoulder_L", RING["F"]),
698	                       ("rail_L", RING["G"]), ("center_top", RING["H"])):
699	            mesh.add_group(f"line/{key}", [v(i, j) for i in range(N_STATIONS)])
700	        mesh.add_group("line/sill_R", [v(i, mirror_index(RING["D"])) for i in range(N_STATIONS)])
701	        mesh.add_group("line/belt_R", [v(i, mirror_index(RING["E"])) for i in range(N_STATIONS)])
702	        mesh.add_group("line/shoulder_R", [v(i, mirror_index(RING["F"])) for i in range(N_STATIONS)])
703	        mesh.add_group("line/rail_R", [v(i, mirror_index(RING["G"])) for i in range(N_STATIONS)])
704	        mesh.add_group("apex_front", [front_apex_i])
705	        mesh.add_group("apex_rear", [rear_apex_i])
706	        mesh.add_group("nose_ring", [v(N_STATIONS - 1, j) for j in range(RING_N)])
707	        mesh.add_group("tail_ring", [v(0, j) for j in range(RING_N)])
708	        for end, rows in (("front", range(off + N_STATIONS, n_rings)), ("rear", range(off - 1, -1, -1))):
709	            rows = list(rows)
710	            mesh.add_group(f"fascia/{end}", [r * RING_N + j for r in rows for j in range(RING_N)])
711	            for name, k in (("face", 1), ("pocket_rim", 3), ("pocket_floor", 4)):
712	                mesh.add_group(f"fascia/{end}_{name}", [rows[k] * RING_N + j for j in range(RING_N)])

"""Canonical parameters of the body generator.

All lengths in metres.  The canonical values describe a mid-size sedan; the
style presets in `styles.py` are full parameter sets for other body types and
become *macro targets* (like MakeHuman's gender/age/weight macros).

Coordinate conventions: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, ground at Z=0, origin at
the middle of the wheelbase.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, fields
import math


@dataclass
class BodyParams:
    # ---- overall proportions -------------------------------------------------
    wheelbase: float = 2.75
    front_overhang: float = 0.95
    rear_overhang: float = 1.05
    width: float = 1.84            # maximum body width (at the belt line)
    ground_clearance: float = 0.15
    # ---- wheels / arches -----------------------------------------------------
    wheel_diameter: float = 0.66
    tire_width: float = 0.225
    arch_gap: float = 0.06         # radial gap between tyre and arch lip
    fender_flare: float = 0.025    # outward bulge of the arch lip
    arch_lip_width: float = 0.020  # radial width of the folded arch flange
    # ---- lower body ----------------------------------------------------------
    sill_height: float = 0.36      # top of the rocker panel
    sill_inset: float = 0.05       # rocker sits this far inboard of the belt line
    rocker_height: float = 0.15   # flat, vertical sill face
    door_step: float = 0.012      # door hem proud of the rocker
    tunnel_height: float = 0.065  # longitudinal floor-pan tunnel (up into cabin)
    tunnel_width: float = 0.28    # full width, including tunnel shoulders
    air_dam_height: float = 0.035 # front skirt below the painted bumper
    rear_valance_height: float = 0.045  # rear skirt below the bumper
    belt_height: float = 0.93      # door shoulder / belt line height
    belt_rake: float = 0.03        # belt rises this much from front door to rear door
    side_bulge: float = 0.02       # convexity of the door skin
    # ---- front end -----------------------------------------------------------
    front_bumper_bottom: float = 0.30
    hood_front_height: float = 0.76
    cowl_height: float = 0.98      # windshield base
    cowl_offset: float = 0.35      # windshield base is this far behind the front axle
    hood_crown: float = 0.03
    nose_width_ratio: float = 0.72  # flat nose width / body width
    front_corner_length: float = 0.55  # plan-view corner rounding run
    front_fascia_rake: float = 0.03    # upper fascia setback (bumper stays vertical)
    bumper_projection: float = 0.035  # bumper face proud of the end ring
    bumper_crease_height: float = 0.60
    hood_overhang: float = 0.03       # hood lip proud of the upper grille face
    front_splitter: float = 0.025    # lower lip projection beyond the bumper
    rear_bumper_crease_height: float = 0.62
    plate_recess: float = 0.025      # depth of the rear licence-plate pocket
    diffuser_step: float = 0.012     # lower rear valance setback
    tailgate_panel: float = 0.0      # lower tailgate panel setback (two-box bodies)
    # ---- greenhouse ----------------------------------------------------------
    windshield_length: float = 0.90    # horizontal run of the windshield
    roof_height: float = 1.45
    roof_drop: float = 0.02            # roof is lower at the rear
    roof_rear_offset: float = 0.33     # roof ends this far ahead of (+) the rear axle
    rear_window_length: float = 0.70
    roof_crown: float = 0.035
    roof_width_ratio: float = 0.68     # roof rail half width / body half width
    shoulder_inset: float = 0.06       # glass base sits inboard of the belt line
    shoulder_rise: float = 0.03
    shoulder_radius: float = 0.025    # definite rolled shoulder, not a spline bulge
    fender_crease: float = 0.012       # hood skin below fender top
    a_pillar_lean: float = 0.98        # fraction of windshield run (1 = parallel to glass)
    a_pillar_width: float = 0.070      # longitudinal pillar band at the cowl
    glass_recess: float = 0.008        # inward normal offset below the frame
    roof_edge_radius: float = 0.025   # rolled roof-side edge
    drip_rail: float = 0.004          # bead proud of the rolled roof edge
    c_pillar_lean: float = 0.35        # as fraction of rear_window_length
    front_door_length: float = 1.32    # cowl -> B pillar centre
    b_pillar_width: float = 0.10
    quarter_window_length: float = 0.03
    c_pillar_width: float = 0.08
    # ---- rear end ------------------------------------------------------------
    deck_height: float = 0.98          # rear window base / trunk lid (or bed rail)
    deck_rear_height: float = 0.94     # trunk lid at the rear edge
    rear_bumper_bottom: float = 0.32
    tail_width_ratio: float = 0.78
    rear_corner_length: float = 0.45
    rear_fascia_rake: float = 0.02     # >0: tail top protrudes over the bumper
    deck_crown: float = 0.02
    bed_depth: float = 0.0             # >0 turns the deck into an open pickup bed
    # ---- non-geometric hints (do not affect topology) -------------------------
    door_count: int = 4

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "BodyParams":
        valid = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
        unknown = set(d) - valid
        if unknown:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown body parameter(s): {sorted(unknown)}")
        return cls(**d)

    @classmethod
    def numeric_fields(cls):
        return [f.name for f in fields(cls) if f.type in ("float", float)]

    # derived layout -----------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def length(self) -> float:
        return self.wheelbase + self.front_overhang + self.rear_overhang

    @property
    def arch_radius(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2 + self.arch_gap

    @property
    def axle_height(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2

    def layout(self) -> dict:
        """Key longitudinal positions.  Greenhouse breakpoints are forced to be
        strictly ordered (min gap 2 cm) so the loft topology is always valid."""
        x_fa = self.wheelbase / 2
        x_ra = -self.wheelbase / 2
        x_front = x_fa + self.front_overhang
        x_rear = x_ra - self.rear_overhang
        gap = 0.02
        # ---- upper (greenhouse) chain, front to back ----
        x_cowl = x_fa - self.cowl_offset
        x_roof_front = x_cowl - self.windshield_length
        x_bp = x_cowl - self.front_door_length
        x_bp_f = x_bp + self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_bp_r = x_bp - self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_roof_rear = x_ra + self.roof_rear_offset
        x_cp_r = x_roof_rear + self.quarter_window_length
        x_cp_f = x_cp_r + self.c_pillar_width
        x_deck = x_roof_rear - self.rear_window_length
        upper = [x_rear, x_deck, x_roof_rear, x_cp_r, x_cp_f, x_bp_r, x_bp_f, x_roof_front, x_cowl, x_front]
        # enforce ordering front->back (front fixed): push items rearward if needed
        for k in range(len(upper) - 2, 0, -1):
            upper[k] = min(upper[k], upper[k + 1] - gap)
        for k in range(1, len(upper) - 1):
            upper[k] = max(upper[k], upper[k - 1] + gap)
        # ---- lower (arch) chain ----
        r = self.arch_radius
        dz = self.sill_height - self.axle_height
        half = math.sqrt(max(r * r - dz * dz, 1e-6)) if dz > 0 else r
        half = min(half, self.wheelbase / 2 - gap, self.front_overhang - 0.1, self.rear_overhang - 0.1)
        lower = [x_rear, x_ra - half, x_ra, x_ra + half, x_fa - half, x_fa, x_fa + half, x_front]
        names_u = ["rear", "deck", "roof_rear", "cp_r", "cp_f", "bp_r", "bp_f", "roof_front", "cowl", "front"]
        names_l = ["rear", "ra_start", "ra", "ra_end", "fa_start", "fa", "fa_end", "front"]
        d = {f"u_{n}": v for n, v in zip(names_u, upper)}
        d.update({f"l_{n}": v for n, v in zip(names_l, lower)})
        d.update(dict(x_front=x_front, x_rear=x_rear, x_fa=x_fa, x_ra=x_ra, arch_half=half, arch_radius=r))
        d["upper"] = upper
        d["lower"] = lower
        return d

1	"""Component framework.
2	
3	A `CarComponent` attaches to a `Connector` and produces a mesh (plus optional
4	sub-connectors of its own, so that e.g. a dashboard can offer gauge-cluster and
5	vent connectors to further components).
6	
7	Type matching uses the connector class hierarchy: a component that `accepts`
8	`PolygonConnector` also accepts `RectangleConnector` and `CircleConnector`.
9	
10	`MorphableComponent` is the target-based flavour and uses *exactly* the same
11	machinery as the body: a fixed-topology parametric generator, a set of
12	`ModifierSpec`s turned into differential targets, and a `fit()` step that maps
13	the connector's geometry (radius, width, height, meta hints) onto modifier
14	values in [-1, 1].
15	
16	Local frame convention for all components: build in the connector's local
17	frame where +Z is the mount normal (things grow along +Z), +X the connector's
18	major direction, origin at the connector origin.  `build()` transforms the
19	result into world space.
20	"""
21	from __future__ import annotations
22	
23	import dataclasses
24	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
25	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple, Type
26	import numpy as np
27	
28	from ..geometry.mesh import Mesh, Material
29	from ..geometry.frame import Frame
30	from ..connectors import Connector, PointConnector, PolygonConnector, RectangleConnector, CircleConnector
31	from ..morph.morphable import MorphableMesh, DifferentialTargetBuilder, ModifierSpec
32	from ..morph.target import Target, Modifier
33	
34	
35	@dataclass
36	class Palette:
37	    """Colours shared across components (from the config)."""
38	    paint: str = "#8a1c1c"
39	    trim: str = "#141416"
40	    chrome: str = "#c9ccd1"
41	    glass: str = "#7fa3b8"
42	    interior: str = "#2a2724"
43	    interior_accent: str = "#6b5a48"
44	    seat: str = "#3a332d"
45	    rim: str = "#b8bcc2"
46	    light: str = "#e8ecef"
47	    taillight: str = "#b3121b"
48	    wood: str = "#5a3b22"
49	    carpet: str = "#1c1a18"
50	    extras: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
51	
52	    def color(self, key: str) -> str:
53	        return self.extras.get(key, getattr(self, key, "#808080"))
54	
55	
56	@dataclass
57	class BuildContext:
58	    measurements: Dict[str, float]
59	    hints: Dict[str, Any]
60	    palette: Palette
61	    rng: np.random.Generator
62	    depth: int = 0
63	
64	    def material(self, name: str, color=None, alpha=1.0, shininess=0.3, emissive=0.0, metallic=0.0) -> Material:
65	        c = self.palette.color(name) if color is None else color
66	        return Material(name, Material.parse_color(c), alpha, shininess, emissive, metallic)
67	
68	
69	@dataclass
70	class ComponentResult:
71	    mesh: Mesh
72	    connectors: List[Connector] = field(default_factory=list)
73	    info: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
74	
75	
76	class CarComponent:
77	    """Base class: procedural component bound to a connector type."""
78	
79	    name: str = "component"
80	    accepts: Tuple[Type[Connector], ...] = (Connector,)
81	    default_for: Tuple[str, ...] = ()       # connector tags this is the default for
82	    priority: int = 0                       # higher wins among defaults for the same tag
83	    options: Dict[str, Any] = {}            # documented defaults
84	    description: str = ""
85	
86	    @classmethod
87	    def can_attach(cls, connector: Connector) -> bool:
88	        return isinstance(connector, cls.accepts)
89	
90	    def resolve_options(self, options: Optional[dict]) -> dict:
91	        o = dict(self.options)
92	        o.update(options or {})
93	        return o
94	
95	    def build(self, connector: Connector, options: Optional[dict], ctx: BuildContext) -> ComponentResult:
96	        if not self.can_attach(connector):
97	            raise TypeError(f"{self.name} accepts {[t.__name__ for t in self.accepts]}, got {type(connector).__name__} ({connector.name})")
98	        opts = self.resolve_options(options)
99	        result = self.build_local(connector, opts, ctx)
100	        result.mesh.apply_frame(connector.frame)
101	        result.mesh.name = f"{connector.name}:{self.name}"
102	        for c in result.connectors:
103	            c.frame = c.frame.transformed(connector.frame.matrix)
104	            if isinstance(c, PolygonConnector):
105	                c._points = connector.frame.to_world(c._points)
106	            c.owner = connector.name
107	            c.name = f"{connector.name}/{c.name}"
108	        return result
109	
110	    # subclasses implement this in the connector's local frame
111	    def build_local(self, connector: Connector, opts: dict, ctx: BuildContext) -> ComponentResult:
112	        raise NotImplementedError
113	
114	    @classmethod
115	    def describe(cls) -> dict:
116	        return {
117	            "name": cls.name,
118	            "accepts": [t.__name__ for t in cls.accepts],
119	            "default_for": list(cls.default_for),
120	            "options": dict(cls.options),
121	            "description": cls.description,
122	            "morphable": issubclass(cls, MorphableComponent),
123	        }
124	
125	
126	class MorphableComponent(CarComponent):
127	    """Target-based component (same logic as the body).
128	
129	    Subclasses define:
130	      params_cls        dataclass of generator parameters (canonical values)
131	      modifier_specs    list[ModifierSpec] -> differential targets
132	      generate(params)  fixed-topology mesh in the local frame
133	      fit(connector, opts, ctx) -> {modifier: value in [-1,1]}
134	      sub_connectors(connector, opts, ctx, values) -> local-frame connectors
135	    Variant generators (e.g. bench vs bucket seat) can be exposed as *macro*
136	    targets by overriding `macros()`.
137	    """
138	
139	    params_cls: Type = None  # type: ignore
140	    modifier_specs: List[ModifierSpec] = []
141	    _libraries: Dict[str, MorphableMesh] = {}
142	
143	    def canonical(self):
144	        return self.params_cls()
145	
146	    def macros(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
147	        return {}
148	
149	    def generate(self, params) -> Mesh:
150	        raise NotImplementedError
151	
152	    def fit(self, connector: Connector, opts: dict, ctx: BuildContext) -> Dict[str, float]:
153	        return {}
154	
155	    def sub_connectors(self, connector: Connector, opts: dict, ctx: BuildContext, values: Dict[str, float]) -> List[Connector]:
156	        return []
157	
158	    def library(self) -> MorphableMesh:
159	        key = f"{type(self).__module__}.{type(self).__name__}"
160	        lib = MorphableComponent._libraries.get(key)
161	        if lib is None:
162	            builder = DifferentialTargetBuilder(self.generate, self.canonical(), name=self.name)
163	            lib = builder.build(self.modifier_specs, macros=self.macros(), macro_group="variant")
164	            MorphableComponent._libraries[key] = lib
165	        return lib
166	
167	    @staticmethod
168	    def ratio_to_value(actual: float, canonical: float, delta_minus: float, delta_plus: float) -> float:
169	        """Map a desired physical value onto a bipolar slider value (clamped)."""
170	        d = actual - canonical
171	        if d >= 0:
172	            return float(np.clip(d / delta_plus, 0, 1)) if delta_plus else 0.0
173	        return float(np.clip(d / delta_minus, -1, 0)) if delta_minus else 0.0
174	
175	    def spec(self, name: str) -> ModifierSpec:
176	        for s in self.modifier_specs:
177	            if (s.name or s.param) == name:
178	                return s
179	        raise KeyError(name)
180	
181	    def value_for(self, name: str, actual: float) -> float:
182	        s = self.spec(name)
183	        canon = getattr(self.canonical(), s.param)
184	        return self.ratio_to_value(actual, canon, s.delta_minus, s.delta_plus)
185	
186	    def materials(self, ctx: BuildContext, opts: dict) -> Dict[str, Material]:
187	        return {}
188	
189	    def build_local(self, connector: Connector, opts: dict, ctx: BuildContext) -> ComponentResult:
190	        values = self.fit(connector, opts, ctx)
191	        lib = self.library()
192	        for k in list(values):
193	            if k not in lib.modifiers:
194	                raise KeyError(f"{self.name}: fit() produced unknown modifier {k!r}")
195	        mesh = lib.morph(values)
196	        mesh.materials.update(self.materials(ctx, opts))
197	        subs = self.sub_connectors(connector, opts, ctx, values)
198	        return ComponentResult(mesh, subs, {"modifier_values": values})
199	
200	
201	# ------------------------------------------------------------------- registry
202	REGISTRY: Dict[str, Type[CarComponent]] = {}
203	
204	
205	def register(cls: Type[CarComponent]) -> Type[CarComponent]:
206	    if not cls.name or cls.name in REGISTRY:
207	        raise ValueError(f"component name missing or duplicate: {cls.name!r}")
208	    REGISTRY[cls.name] = cls
209	    return cls
210	
211	
212	def get_component(name: str) -> CarComponent:
213	    if name not in REGISTRY:
214	        raise KeyError(f"unknown component {name!r}; available: {sorted(REGISTRY)}")
215	    return REGISTRY[name]()
216	
217	
218	def default_component_for(connector: Connector) -> Optional[str]:
219	    """Pick the default component for a connector by its tags (then by type)."""
220	    best: Tuple[int, str] | None = None
221	    for name, cls in REGISTRY.items():
222	        if not cls.can_attach(connector):
223	            continue
224	        for tag in cls.default_for:
225	            if tag in connector.tags or tag == connector.name:
226	                score = cls.priority * 10 + (5 if tag == connector.name else 0)
227	                if best is None or score > best[0]:
228	                    best = (score, name)
229	    return best[1] if best else None
230	
231	
232	def describe_all() -> List[dict]:
233	    return [cls.describe() for cls in REGISTRY.values()]

1	"""Derive measurements, feature lines (seams) and connectors from a morphed body.
2	
3	Everything here reads *vertex groups* and the aperture grid recorded by the
4	generator, never the generator parameters, so connectors follow the mesh
5	wherever the targets move it (the MakeHuman "joints follow the mesh" idea).
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
10	import numpy as np
11	
12	from ..geometry.mesh import Mesh
13	from ..geometry.frame import Frame
14	from ..connectors import Connector, PointConnector, PolygonConnector, RectangleConnector, CircleConnector
15	from .generator import RING, RING_N, HALF_N, N_STATIONS, mirror_index, station_index
16	
17	J = RING  # shorthand: J["F"] etc.
18	
19	
20	# ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
21	def vidx(mesh: Mesh, station: int, j: int) -> int:
22	    return (station + mesh.meta["ring_offset"]) * RING_N + j
23	
24	
25	def ring_pts(mesh: Mesh, station: int) -> np.ndarray:
26	    a = vidx(mesh, station, 0)
27	    return mesh.vertices[a : a + RING_N]
28	
29	
30	def fit_circle(pts_xz: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
31	    """Algebraic least-squares circle fit in 2-D -> (cx, cz, r)."""
32	    x, y = pts_xz[:, 0], pts_xz[:, 1]
33	    A = np.column_stack([x, y, np.ones_like(x)])
34	    b = x * x + y * y
35	    sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
36	    cx, cy = sol[0] / 2, sol[1] / 2
37	    r = np.sqrt(max(sol[2] + cx * cx + cy * cy, 1e-9))
38	    return float(cx), float(cy), float(r)
39	
40	
41	def surface_line_at_x(mesh: Mesh, x_target: float, j_from: int, j_to: int, stations=None) -> np.ndarray:
42	    """Polyline on the loft surface at constant x, for ring indices j_from..j_to.
43	    Each ring index j is a longitudinal vertex chain; we interpolate along it."""
44	    stations = range(N_STATIONS) if stations is None else stations
45	    out = []
46	    step = 1 if j_to >= j_from else -1
47	    for j in range(j_from, j_to + step, step):
48	        chain = np.array([mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in stations])
49	        xs = chain[:, 0]
50	        k = np.clip(np.searchsorted(xs, x_target) - 1, 0, len(xs) - 2)
51	        t = np.clip((x_target - xs[k]) / max(xs[k + 1] - xs[k], 1e-9), 0, 1)
52	        out.append(chain[k] + (chain[k + 1] - chain[k]) * t)
53	    return np.asarray(out)
54	
55	
56	def aperture_loop(mesh: Mesh, name: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Tuple[int, int], np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
57	    """Ordered vertex loop around a grid aperture + (rows, cols) + outward normal
58	    + the full vertex grid (rows, cols, 3) the aperture was cut from."""
59	    r0, r1, j0, j1 = mesh.meta["aperture_rects"][name]
60	    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
61	    # rows are loft ring rows (already include the fascia offset); convert to station space
62	    r0s, r1s = r0 - off, r1 - off + 1
63	    j1e = j1 + 1
64	    loop = []
65	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j0) for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)]
66	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r1s, j) for j in range(j0 + 1, j1e + 1)]
67	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r, j1e) for r in range(r1s - 1, r0s - 1, -1)]
68	    loop += [vidx(mesh, r0s, j) for j in range(j1e - 1, j0, -1)]
69	    pts = mesh.vertices[loop]
70	    grid = np.array([[mesh.vertices[vidx(mesh, r, j)] for j in range(j0, j1e + 1)] for r in range(r0s, r1s + 1)])
71	    faces = mesh.zones[name]
72	    if "_face_normals" not in mesh.meta:
73	        mesh.meta["_face_normals"] = mesh.face_normals()
74	    fn = mesh.meta["_face_normals"][faces].mean(axis=0)
75	    fn /= max(np.linalg.norm(fn), 1e-9)
76	    return pts, (r1s - r0s + 1, j1e - j0 + 1), fn, grid

79	def fascia_point(mesh: Mesh, end: str, z: float, y: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
80	    """Mount on the actual stepped fascia, including the rear plate pocket.
81	
82	    Intersect an X ray with the fascia triangles instead of treating a bumper,
83	    upper panel and recess as one raked plane. All inputs come from the morphed
84	    mesh, so differential targets and style blends move the mounts with it.
85	    """
86	    ids = np.append(mesh.groups[f"fascia/{end}"], mesh.groups[f"apex_{end}"])
87	    mask = np.zeros(mesh.n_vertices, dtype=bool)
88	    mask[ids] = True
89	    tris, _ = mesh.triangulated()
90	    triangles = mesh.vertices[tris[mask[tris].all(axis=1)]]
91	    a, b, c = triangles[:, 0], triangles[:, 1], triangles[:, 2]
92	    u, v = b[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:], c[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:]
93	    q = np.array([y, z]) - a[:, 1:]
94	    det = u[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * v[:, 0]
95	    valid = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
96	    den = np.where(valid, det, 1.0)
97	    s = (q[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - q[:, 1] * v[:, 0]) / den
98	    t = (u[:, 0] * q[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * q[:, 0]) / den
99	    valid &= (s >= -1e-8) & (t >= -1e-8) & (s + t <= 1 + 1e-8)
100	    x = a[:, 0] + s * (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) + t * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
101	    if valid.any():
102	        return np.array([x[valid].max() if end == "front" else x[valid].min(), y, z])
103	    # Out-of-range custom hints still get a finite nearest-surface mount.
104	    pts = mesh.vertices[ids]
105	    nearest = pts[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(pts[:, 1:] - [y, z], axis=1))]
106	    return np.array([nearest[0], y, z])

109	# ------------------------------------------------------------ measurements
110	def measure(mesh: Mesh) -> Dict[str, float]:
111	    V = mesh.vertices
112	    G = mesh.groups
113	
114	    def ring(name):
115	        return V[G[f"ring/{name}"]]
116	
117	    def lring(name):
118	        return V[G[f"lring/{name}"]]
119	
120	    H, E, F, Gj, D, A = J["H"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["D"], J["A"]
121	    cowl, rf, rr, deck = ring("cowl"), ring("roof_front"), ring("roof_rear"), ring("deck")
122	    bp = ring("bp_r")
123	    m: Dict[str, float] = {}
124	    m["x_front"] = float(V[G["fascia/front"]][:, 0].max())
125	    m["x_rear"] = float(V[G["fascia/rear"]][:, 0].min())
126	    m["length"] = m["x_front"] - m["x_rear"]
127	    m["width"] = float(2 * np.abs(V[:, 1]).max())
128	    m["height"] = float(V[:, 2].max())
129	    m["x_cowl"], m["z_cowl"] = float(cowl[H, 0]), float(cowl[H, 2])
130	    m["x_roof_front"], m["z_roof_front"] = float(rf[H, 0]), float(rf[H, 2])
131	    m["x_roof_rear"], m["z_roof_rear"] = float(rr[H, 0]), float(rr[H, 2])
132	    m["x_deck"], m["z_deck"] = float(deck[H, 0]), float(deck[H, 2])
133	    m["x_bpillar"] = float(0.5 * (ring("bp_r")[Gj, 0] + ring("bp_f")[Gj, 0]))
134	    m["roof_half_width"] = float(0.5 * (rf[Gj, 1] + rr[Gj, 1]))
135	    # cabin section at the B pillar
136	    m["z_belt"] = float(bp[E, 2])
137	    m["y_belt"] = float(bp[E, 1])
138	    m["y_shoulder"] = float(bp[F, 1])
139	    m["z_sill"] = float(np.mean([lring("ra_end")[D, 2], lring("fa_start")[D, 2]]))
140	    m["y_sill"] = float(lring("fa_start")[D, 1])
141	    cabin_st = range(station_index("bp_r") - 4, station_index("bp_f") + 4)
142	    # A is the raised tunnel crown; the flat pan is sampled at B.
143	    m["z_floor"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, J["B"]), 2] for i in cabin_st]))
144	    m["y_floor_edge"] = float(np.mean([V[vidx(mesh, i, J["B"]), 1] for i in cabin_st]))
145	    # wheels
146	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
147	        pts = V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, [0, 2]]
148	        cx, cz, r = fit_circle(pts)
149	        m[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], m[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], m[f"arch_{tag}_r"] = cx, cz, r
150	        m[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] = float(np.mean(V[G[f"arch_{tag}_L"]][:, 1]))
151	    m["wheelbase"] = m["wheel_front_x"] - m["wheel_rear_x"]
152	    m["track"] = 2 * m["wheel_front_y"]
153	    # nose / tail faces
154	    nose, tail = V[G["nose_ring"]], V[G["tail_ring"]]
155	    m["nose_z_top"], m["nose_z_bottom"] = float(nose[H, 2]), float(nose[A, 2])
156	    m["nose_half_width"] = float(nose[E, 1])
157	    m["nose_top_half_width"] = float(nose[Gj, 1])
158	    m["tail_z_top"], m["tail_z_bottom"] = float(tail[H, 2]), float(tail[A, 2])
159	    m["tail_half_width"] = float(tail[E, 1])
160	    m["tail_top_half_width"] = float(tail[Gj, 1])
161	    m["bed"] = float(max(0.0, V[G["ring/deck"]][H, 2] - V[vidx(mesh, station_index("deck") // 2, H), 2]))
162	    m["has_bed"] = float(m["bed"] > 0.2)
163	    return m

166	# ------------------------------------------------------------ feature lines
167	def feature_lines(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], door_count: int = 4) -> List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]]:
168	    V = mesh.vertices
169	    lines: List[Tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
170	    D, E, F, Gj, H = J["D"], J["E"], J["F"], J["G"], J["H"]
171	    st = station_index
172	    off = mesh.meta["ring_offset"]
173	
174	    def chain(j, i0, i1):
175	        return np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, j)] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
176	
177	    def ring_seg(i, j0, j1):
178	        r = ring_pts(mesh, i)
179	        idx = list(range(j0, j1 + 1)) if j1 >= j0 else list(range(j0, j1 - 1, -1))
180	        return r[idx]
181	
182	    for side, mir in (("L", lambda j: j), ("R", mirror_index)):
183	        # hood: side seams along the fender/hood edge, rear seam across the cowl
184	        lines.append((f"hood_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), st("cowl") + 1, st("front") - 3)))
185	        # trunk lid side seams
186	        lines.append((f"deck_seam_{side}", chain(mir(F), 3, st("deck"))))
187	        # B pillar seams sill -> roof rail
188	        for nm in ("bp_r", "bp_f"):
189	            lines.append((f"{nm}_seam_{side}", ring_seg(st(nm), mir(D), mir(Gj))))
190	        # front door leading edge: vertical on the door, then along the A pillar aperture edge
191	        x_fd = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
192	        vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_fd, mir(D), mir(E))
193	        pil = ring_seg(st("roof_front"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
194	        lines.append((f"front_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
195	        if door_count >= 4:
196	            x_rd = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02
197	            vert = surface_line_at_x(mesh, x_rd, mir(D), mir(E))
198	            pil = ring_seg(st("cp_f"), mir(F), mir(Gj))
199	            lines.append((f"rear_door_seam_{side}", np.vstack([vert, pil])))
200	    # transverse seams (over the top)
201	    lines.append(("hood_rear_seam", ring_seg(st("cowl") + 1, F, mirror_index(F))))
202	    lines.append(("deck_front_seam", ring_seg(st("deck"), F, mirror_index(F))))
203	    # nose & tail hood/trunk front edges
204	    lines.append(("hood_front_seam", ring_seg(st("front") - 3, F, mirror_index(F))))
205	    return lines

208	# --------------------------------------------------------------- connectors
209	def emit_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
210	    """All connectors the body emits.  `hints` carries non-geometric options:
211	    door_count, seat_rows ('auto'|int), drive ('left'|'right'), fuel_side."""
212	    V = mesh.vertices
213	    out: List[Connector] = []
214	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
215	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
216	    ysign_driver = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
217	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
218	
219	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- wheels
220	    tire_w = float(hints.get("tire_width", 0.225))
221	    for tag in ("front", "rear"):
222	        cx, cz, r = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_x"], meas[f"wheel_{tag}_z"], meas[f"arch_{tag}_r"]
223	        tire_r = r - float(hints.get("arch_gap", 0.06))
224	        y = meas[f"wheel_{tag}_y"] - tire_w / 2 - 0.01
225	        for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
226	            fr = Frame.from_normal([cx, ys * y, cz], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X)
227	            out.append(CircleConnector(f"wheel_{tag}_{side}", fr, tire_r, tags=["wheel", f"wheel_{tag}"],
228	                                       meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "axle": tag,
229	                                             "tire_width": tire_w, "arch_radius": r, "steer": tag == "front"}))
230	
231	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- apertures
232	    for name in mesh.meta["aperture_rects"]:
233	        pts, grid, nrm, grid_pts = aperture_loop(mesh, name)
234	        short = name.split("/", 1)[1]
235	        kind = "glass" if short.startswith(("glass", "windshield", "rear_window")) else "light"
236	        tags = [kind, short.rstrip("_LR").rstrip("_")]
237	        if short.startswith("headlight"):
238	            tags.append("headlight")
239	        if short.startswith("taillight"):
240	            tags.append("taillight")
241	        side = "left" if short.endswith("_L") else "right" if short.endswith("_R") else "center"
242	        x_hint = Y if kind == "glass" else X
243	        conn = PolygonConnector.from_points(name.replace("aperture/", ""), pts, normal_hint=nrm, x_hint=x_hint,
244	                                            tags=tags, meta={"grid": list(grid), "grid_points": grid_pts, "side": side, "aperture": True})
245	        out.append(conn)
246	
247	    # --------------------------------------------------------- exterior bits
248	    nose = V[mesh.groups["nose_ring"]]
249	    tail = V[mesh.groups["tail_ring"]]
250	    apex_f = V[mesh.groups["apex_front"]][0]
251	    apex_r = V[mesh.groups["apex_rear"]][0]
252	    nose_n, tail_n = X, -X
253	    z_nose_top, z_nose_bot = meas["nose_z_top"], meas["nose_z_bottom"]
254	    z_tail_top, z_tail_bot = meas["tail_z_top"], meas["tail_z_bottom"]
255	    nose_w = 2 * meas["nose_top_half_width"]
256	    tail_w = 2 * meas["tail_top_half_width"]
257	
258	    def on_face(apex, nrm, z, ahead=0.004, y=0.0):
259	        end = "front" if nrm[0] > 0 else "rear"
260	        return fascia_point(mesh, end, z, y) + nrm * ahead
261	
262	    grille_z = z_nose_top - 0.18
263	    out.append(RectangleConnector("grille", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
264	                                  min(nose_w * 0.62, 1.1), 0.17, tags=["grille"], meta={"style_hint": hints.get("style", "sedan")}))
265	    intake_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16
266	    out.append(RectangleConnector("intake", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, intake_z), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
267	                                  min(nose_w * 0.8, 1.2), 0.14, tags=["grille", "intake"], meta={"lower": True}))
268	    plate_z = z_nose_bot + 0.16 + 0.15
269	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, (grille_z + intake_z) / 2 - 0.02, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y),
270	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "front"}))
271	    out.append(RectangleConnector("plate_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.5 * (z_tail_top - z_tail_bot), 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y),
272	                                  0.52, 0.11, tags=["plate"], meta={"position": "rear"}))
273	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_front", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_f, nose_n, grille_z + 0.11, 0.012), nose_n, x_hint=-Y), tags=["badge"]))
274	    out.append(PointConnector("badge_rear", Frame.from_normal(on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_top - 0.16, 0.012), tail_n, x_hint=Y), tags=["badge"]))
275	    # exhaust tips
276	    for side, ys in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
277	        p = on_face(apex_r, tail_n, z_tail_bot + 0.10, 0.0,
278	                    y=ys * (meas["tail_half_width"] - 0.32))
279	        out.append(CircleConnector(f"exhaust_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, tail_n, x_hint=Y), 0.038, tags=["exhaust"],
280	                                   meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
281	    # side mirrors at the front-bottom corner of the front door glass
282	    st = station_index
283	    for side, mir, ys in (("L", lambda j: j, 1.0), ("R", mirror_index, -1.0)):
284	        p = V[vidx(mesh, st("roof_front"), mir(J["F"]))].copy()
285	        p[0] += 0.02
286	        p[2] += 0.02
287	        out.append(PointConnector(f"mirror_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, [0.0, ys, 0.0], x_hint=X), tags=["mirror"],
288	                                  meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
289	        # door handles: on the door skin just below the belt, mid-door
290	        x_fd0 = meas["wheel_front_x"] - meas["arch_front_r"] - 0.06
291	        x_fd1 = meas["x_bpillar"]
292	        for door, x0, x1, ok in (("front", x_fd0, x_fd1, True),
293	                                 ("rear", x_fd1, meas["wheel_rear_x"] + meas["arch_rear_r"] + 0.02, door_count >= 4)):
294	            if not ok:
295	                continue
296	            xh = x1 + 0.62 * (x0 - x1)
297	            zh = meas["z_belt"] - 0.11
298	            line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xh, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
299	            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zh)))
300	            p = line[k].copy()
301	            nrm = np.array([0.0, ys, 0.0])
302	            out.append(PointConnector(f"handle_{door}_{side}", Frame.from_normal(p, nrm, x_hint=X), tags=["handle"],
303	                                      meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "door": door}))
304	        # roof rails along the roof edge (upper chain is numbered rear -> front)
305	        i0, i1 = st("roof_rear") + 1, st("roof_front") - 1
306	        if i1 > i0 + 1:
307	            pts = np.array([V[vidx(mesh, i, mir(J["G"]))] for i in range(i0, i1 + 1)])
308	            length = float(pts[-1, 0] - pts[0, 0])
309	            c = pts.mean(axis=0)
310	            fr = Frame.from_normal(c, Z, x_hint=X)
311	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"roof_rail_{side}", fr, abs(length), 0.05, tags=["roof_rail"],
312	                                          meta={"side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right", "path": pts}))
313	    # fuel cap on the rear quarter (fuel side from hints)
314	    fs = hints.get("fuel_side", "left")
315	    ys = 1.0 if fs == "left" else -1.0
316	    mir = (lambda j: j) if ys > 0 else mirror_index
317	    xf = meas["wheel_rear_x"] + 0.08
318	    line = surface_line_at_x(mesh, xf, mir(J["D"]), mir(J["E"]))
319	    zf = meas["z_belt"] - 0.20
320	    k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(line[:, 2] - zf)))
321	    out.append(CircleConnector("fuel_cap", Frame.from_normal(line[k], [0, ys, 0], x_hint=X), 0.065, tags=["fuel_cap"],
322	                               meta={"side": fs}))
323	    # antenna / shark fin near the rear of the roof
324	    i_ant = st("roof_rear") + 1
325	    p = V[vidx(mesh, i_ant, J["H"])]
326	    out.append(PointConnector("antenna", Frame.from_normal(p, Z, x_hint=X), tags=["antenna"]))
327	
328	    # -------------------------------------------------------------- interior
329	    out += interior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
330	    from .connectors_extra import extra_exterior_connectors
331	    out += extra_exterior_connectors(mesh, meas, hints)
332	    return out

335	def _face_normal_from_ring(ring: np.ndarray, sign: float) -> np.ndarray:
336	    top = ring[J["H"]]
337	    bot = ring[J["A"]]
338	    d = top - bot  # face direction (mostly vertical, tilted by the rake)
339	    n = np.array([d[2], 0.0, -d[0]])
340	    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
341	    if np.sign(n[0]) != np.sign(sign):
342	        n = -n
343	    return n

346	def interior_connectors(mesh: Mesh, meas: Dict[str, float], hints: Dict) -> List[Connector]:
347	    V = mesh.vertices
348	    out: List[Connector] = []
349	    X, Y, Z = np.eye(3)
350	    door_count = int(hints.get("door_count", 4))
351	    drive = hints.get("drive", "left")
352	    ysd = 1.0 if drive == "left" else -1.0
353	    st = station_index
354	
355	    floor = meas["z_floor"] + 0.05             # cabin floor (carpet top)
356	    inner_half = meas["y_shoulder"] - 0.08     # cabin inner half width at the belt
357	    roof_h = meas["z_roof_front"]
358	    h_point = float(hints.get("h_point_height", np.clip(0.17 + (roof_h - 1.2) * 0.4, 0.17, 0.38)))
359	    x_h1 = meas["x_cowl"] - float(hints.get("front_h_point_offset", 0.95))
360	    z_h1 = floor + h_point
361	    y_seat = min(0.42, inner_half - 0.36)
362	    x_firewall = meas["x_cowl"] + 0.12
363	    has_bed = meas.get("has_bed", 0.0) > 0.5
364	    x_cab_rear = min(meas["x_roof_rear"] - 0.05, meas["x_deck"] + 0.55) if not has_bed else meas["x_deck"] - 0.05
365	    x_cab_rear = min(x_cab_rear, meas["x_roof_rear"] + 0.15)
366	    # seat rows -----------------------------------------------------------------
367	    rows_cfg = hints.get("seat_rows", "auto")
368	    pitch = 0.86
369	    row_x = [x_h1]
370	    while len(row_x) < 3 and row_x[-1] - pitch - 0.30 > x_cab_rear - 0.12:
371	        row_x.append(row_x[-1] - pitch)
372	    if rows_cfg != "auto":
373	        rows_cfg = int(rows_cfg)
374	        row_x = [x_h1 - k * pitch for k in range(max(1, rows_cfg))]
375	    n_rows = len(row_x)
376	    seat_w, seat_d = 0.52, 0.55
377	    for r, xh in enumerate(row_x):
378	        if r == 0:
379	            for name, ys in (("driver", ysd), ("passenger", -ysd)):
380	                fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.12, ys * y_seat, floor], Z, x_hint=X)
381	                out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_front_{name}", fr, seat_d, seat_w, tags=["seat", "seat_front"],
382	                                              meta={"row": 0, "role": name, "h_point_height": h_point,
383	                                                    "headroom": roof_h - 0.03 - floor, "side": "left" if ys > 0 else "right"}))
384	        else:
385	            bench_w = 2 * inner_half - 0.12
386	            room = row_x[r - 1] - xh
387	            fr = Frame.from_normal([xh + 0.10, 0.0, floor + (0.02 if r == 1 else 0.0)], Z, x_hint=X)
388	            out.append(RectangleConnector(f"seat_row{r + 1}", fr, seat_d - 0.05, bench_w, tags=["seat", "seat_bench", f"seat_row{r + 1}"],
389	                                          meta={"row": r, "role": "bench", "h_point_height": h_point - 0.02 * r,
390	                                                "headroom": meas["z_roof_rear"] - 0.03 - floor if r == n_rows - 1 else roof_h - floor,
391	                                                "legroom": room}))
392	    # steering wheel / column ---------------------------------------------------
393	    col_angle = np.radians(float(hints.get("column_angle", 24.0)))
394	    wheel_c = np.array([x_h1 + 0.52, ysd * y_seat, z_h1 + 0.32])
395	    n = np.array([-np.cos(col_angle), 0.0, np.sin(col_angle)])
396	    out.append(CircleConnector("steering_wheel", Frame.from_normal(wheel_c, n, x_hint=Y), 0.185, tags=["steering_wheel"],
397	                               meta={"column_angle_deg": float(np.degrees(col_angle)), "column_length": 0.35}))
398	    # dashboard: interior section just behind the windshield base ----------------
399	    cowl = ring_pts(mesh, st("cowl"))
400	    yE = cowl[J["E"], 1] - 0.09
401	    z_top = meas["z_cowl"] - 0.03
402	    z_lo = floor + 0.32
403	    x_dash = meas["x_cowl"] - 0.02
404	    dash_pts = np.array([
405	        [x_dash, -yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_lo], [x_dash, yE, z_top - 0.12], [x_dash, yE - 0.10, z_top],
406	        [x_dash, -yE + 0.10, z_top], [x_dash, -yE, z_top - 0.12],
407	    ])
408	    dash = PolygonConnector.from_points("dashboard", dash_pts, normal_hint=-X, x_hint=-Y, tags=["dashboard"],
409	                                        meta={"driver_y": ysd * y_seat, "depth": 0.55, "floor": floor,

"""Canonical parameters of the body generator.

All lengths in metres.  The canonical values describe a mid-size sedan; the
style presets in `styles.py` are full parameter sets for other body types and
become *macro targets* (like MakeHuman's gender/age/weight macros).

Coordinate conventions: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, ground at Z=0, origin at
the middle of the wheelbase.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, fields
import math


@dataclass
class BodyParams:
    # ---- overall proportions -------------------------------------------------
    wheelbase: float = 2.824
    front_overhang: float = 0.975
    rear_overhang: float = 1.080
    width: float = 1.839           # maximum body width (at the belt line)
    ground_clearance: float = 0.15
    # ---- wheels / arches -----------------------------------------------------
    wheel_diameter: float = 0.6683 # 215/55 R17, Camry LE reference
    tire_width: float = 0.215
    arch_gap: float = 0.06         # radial gap between tyre and arch lip
    fender_flare: float = 0.025    # outward bulge of the arch lip
    arch_lip_width: float = 0.020  # radial width of the folded arch flange
    # ---- lower body ----------------------------------------------------------
    sill_height: float = 0.36      # top of the rocker panel
    sill_inset: float = 0.05       # rocker sits this far inboard of the belt line
    rocker_height: float = 0.15   # flat, vertical sill face
    door_step: float = 0.012      # door hem proud of the rocker
    tunnel_height: float = 0.065  # longitudinal floor-pan tunnel (up into cabin)
    tunnel_width: float = 0.28    # full width, including tunnel shoulders
    air_dam_height: float = 0.035 # front skirt below the painted bumper
    rear_valance_height: float = 0.045  # rear skirt below the bumper
    belt_height: float = 0.93      # door shoulder / belt line height
    belt_rake: float = 0.03        # belt rises this much from front door to rear door
    side_bulge: float = 0.02       # convexity of the door skin
    # ---- front end -----------------------------------------------------------
    front_bumper_bottom: float = 0.30
    hood_front_height: float = 0.76
    cowl_height: float = 0.98      # windshield base
    cowl_offset: float = 0.35      # windshield base is this far behind the front axle
    hood_crown: float = 0.03
    nose_width_ratio: float = 0.72  # flat nose width / body width
    front_corner_length: float = 0.55  # plan-view corner rounding run
    front_fascia_rake: float = 0.03    # upper fascia setback (bumper stays vertical)
    bumper_projection: float = 0.035  # bumper face proud of the end ring
    bumper_crease_height: float = 0.60
    hood_overhang: float = 0.03       # hood lip proud of the upper grille face
    front_splitter: float = 0.025    # lower lip projection beyond the bumper
    rear_bumper_crease_height: float = 0.62
    plate_recess: float = 0.025      # depth of the rear licence-plate pocket
    diffuser_step: float = 0.012     # lower rear valance setback
    tailgate_panel: float = 0.0      # lower tailgate panel setback (two-box bodies)
    # ---- greenhouse ----------------------------------------------------------
    windshield_length: float = 0.90    # horizontal run of the windshield
    roof_height: float = 1.45
    roof_drop: float = 0.02            # roof is lower at the rear
    roof_rear_offset: float = 0.33     # roof ends this far ahead of (+) the rear axle
    rear_window_length: float = 0.70
    roof_crown: float = 0.035
    roof_width_ratio: float = 0.68     # roof rail half width / body half width
    shoulder_inset: float = 0.06       # glass base sits inboard of the belt line
    shoulder_rise: float = 0.03
    shoulder_radius: float = 0.025    # definite rolled shoulder, not a spline bulge
    fender_crease: float = 0.012       # hood skin below fender top
    a_pillar_lean: float = 0.98        # fraction of windshield run (1 = parallel to glass)
    a_pillar_width: float = 0.070      # longitudinal pillar band at the cowl
    glass_recess: float = 0.008        # inward normal offset below the frame
    roof_edge_radius: float = 0.025   # rolled roof-side edge
    drip_rail: float = 0.004          # bead proud of the rolled roof edge
    c_pillar_lean: float = 0.35        # as fraction of rear_window_length
    front_door_length: float = 1.32    # cowl -> B pillar centre
    b_pillar_width: float = 0.10
    quarter_window_length: float = 0.03
    c_pillar_width: float = 0.08
    # ---- rear end ------------------------------------------------------------
    deck_height: float = 0.98          # rear window base / trunk lid (or bed rail)
    deck_rear_height: float = 0.94     # trunk lid at the rear edge
    rear_bumper_bottom: float = 0.32
    tail_width_ratio: float = 0.78
    rear_corner_length: float = 0.45
    rear_fascia_rake: float = 0.02     # >0: tail top protrudes over the bumper
    deck_crown: float = 0.02
    bed_depth: float = 0.0             # >0 turns the deck into an open pickup bed
    # ---- non-geometric hints (do not affect topology) -------------------------
    door_count: int = 4

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "BodyParams":
        valid = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
        unknown = set(d) - valid
        if unknown:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown body parameter(s): {sorted(unknown)}")
        return cls(**d)

    @classmethod
    def numeric_fields(cls):
        return [f.name for f in fields(cls) if f.type in ("float", float)]

    # derived layout -----------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def length(self) -> float:
        return self.wheelbase + self.front_overhang + self.rear_overhang

    @property
    def arch_radius(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2 + self.arch_gap

    @property
    def axle_height(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2

    def layout(self) -> dict:
        """Key longitudinal positions.  Greenhouse breakpoints are forced to be
        strictly ordered (min gap 2 cm) so the loft topology is always valid."""
        x_fa = self.wheelbase / 2
        x_ra = -self.wheelbase / 2
        x_front = x_fa + self.front_overhang
        x_rear = x_ra - self.rear_overhang
        gap = 0.02
        # ---- upper (greenhouse) chain, front to back ----
        x_cowl = x_fa - self.cowl_offset
        x_roof_front = x_cowl - self.windshield_length
        x_bp = x_cowl - self.front_door_length
        x_bp_f = x_bp + self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_bp_r = x_bp - self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_roof_rear = x_ra + self.roof_rear_offset
        x_cp_r = x_roof_rear + self.quarter_window_length
        x_cp_f = x_cp_r + self.c_pillar_width
        x_deck = x_roof_rear - self.rear_window_length
        upper = [x_rear, x_deck, x_roof_rear, x_cp_r, x_cp_f, x_bp_r, x_bp_f, x_roof_front, x_cowl, x_front]
        # enforce ordering front->back (front fixed): push items rearward if needed
        for k in range(len(upper) - 2, 0, -1):
            upper[k] = min(upper[k], upper[k + 1] - gap)
        for k in range(1, len(upper) - 1):
            upper[k] = max(upper[k], upper[k - 1] + gap)
        # ---- lower (arch) chain ----
        r = self.arch_radius
        dz = self.sill_height - self.axle_height
        half = math.sqrt(max(r * r - dz * dz, 1e-6)) if dz > 0 else r
        half = min(half, self.wheelbase / 2 - gap, self.front_overhang - 0.1, self.rear_overhang - 0.1)

+def fascia_point(mesh: Mesh, end: str, z: float, y: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Mount on the actual stepped fascia, including the rear plate pocket.
+
+    Intersect an X ray with the fascia triangles instead of treating a bumper,
+    upper panel and recess as one raked plane. All inputs come from the morphed
+    mesh, so differential targets and style blends move the mounts with it.
+    """
+    ids = np.append(mesh.groups[f"fascia/{end}"], mesh.groups[f"apex_{end}"])
+    mask = np.zeros(mesh.n_vertices, dtype=bool)
+    mask[ids] = True
+    tris, _ = mesh.triangulated()
+    triangles = mesh.vertices[tris[mask[tris].all(axis=1)]]
+    a, b, c = triangles[:, 0], triangles[:, 1], triangles[:, 2]
+    u, v = b[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:], c[:, 1:] - a[:, 1:]
+    q = np.array([y, z]) - a[:, 1:]
+    det = u[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * v[:, 0]
+    valid = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
+    den = np.where(valid, det, 1.0)
+    s = (q[:, 0] * v[:, 1] - q[:, 1] * v[:, 0]) / den
+    t = (u[:, 0] * q[:, 1] - u[:, 1] * q[:, 0]) / den
+    valid &= (s >= -1e-8) & (t >= -1e-8) & (s + t <= 1 + 1e-8)
+    x = a[:, 0] + s * (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) + t * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
+    if valid.any():
+        return np.array([x[valid].max() if end == "front" else x[valid].min(), y, z])
+    # Out-of-range custom hints still get a finite nearest-surface mount.
+    pts = mesh.vertices[ids]
+    nearest = pts[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(pts[:, 1:] - [y, z], axis=1))]
+    return np.array([nearest[0], y, z])

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Station allocation (fixed counts per chain interval)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
UPPER_COUNTS = [6, 6, 1, 1, 6, 1, 3, 8, 12]   # 9 intervals of the greenhouse chain
LOWER_COUNTS = [6, 5, 5, 12, 5, 5, 6]          # 7 intervals of the arch chain
assert sum(UPPER_COUNTS) == sum(LOWER_COUNTS)
N_STATIONS = sum(UPPER_COUNTS) + 1              # 45 rings in the main loft
N_FASCIA = 2                                    # extra shrinking rings per end
UPPER_NAMES = ["rear", "deck", "roof_rear", "cp_r", "cp_f", "bp_r", "bp_f", "roof_front", "cowl", "front"]
LOWER_NAMES = ["rear", "ra_start", "ra", "ra_end", "fa_start", "fa", "fa_end", "front"]


def _station_positions(breakpoints: List[float], counts: List[int]) -> np.ndarray:
    xs = []
    for k, n in enumerate(counts):
        a, b = breakpoints[k], breakpoints[k + 1]
        xs.extend(np.linspace(a, b, n, endpoint=False))
    xs.append(breakpoints[-1])
    return np.asarray(xs)


def station_index(name: str, chain: str = "upper") -> int:
    """Ring index of a named breakpoint ('cowl', 'ra', ...)."""
    names, counts = (UPPER_NAMES, UPPER_COUNTS) if chain == "upper" else (LOWER_NAMES, LOWER_COUNTS)
    k = names.index(name)
    return int(sum(counts[:k]))


PAINT, GLASS_ZONE, UNDERBODY, TRIM = "paint", "aperture", "underbody", "trim"


class BodyGenerator:
    """params -> fixed-topology body Mesh (with zones, groups, landmarks)."""

        self.x_hi = _station_positions(self.L["upper"], UPPER_COUNTS)

"""Canonical parameters of the body generator.

All lengths in metres.  The canonical values describe a mid-size sedan; the
style presets in `styles.py` are full parameter sets for other body types and
become *macro targets* (like MakeHuman's gender/age/weight macros).

Coordinate conventions: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, ground at Z=0, origin at
the middle of the wheelbase.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, fields
import math


@dataclass
class BodyParams:
    # ---- overall proportions -------------------------------------------------
    wheelbase: float = 2.824
    front_overhang: float = 0.975
    rear_overhang: float = 1.080
    width: float = 1.839           # maximum body width (at the belt line)
    ground_clearance: float = 0.15
    # ---- wheels / arches -----------------------------------------------------
    wheel_diameter: float = 0.6683 # 215/55 R17, Camry LE reference
    tire_width: float = 0.215
    arch_gap: float = 0.06         # radial gap between tyre and arch lip
    fender_flare: float = 0.025    # outward bulge of the arch lip
    arch_lip_width: float = 0.020  # radial width of the folded arch flange
    # ---- lower body ----------------------------------------------------------
    sill_height: float = 0.36      # top of the rocker panel
    sill_inset: float = 0.05       # rocker sits this far inboard of the belt line
    rocker_height: float = 0.15   # flat, vertical sill face
    door_step: float = 0.012      # door hem proud of the rocker
    tunnel_height: float = 0.065  # longitudinal floor-pan tunnel (up into cabin)
    tunnel_width: float = 0.28    # full width, including tunnel shoulders
    air_dam_height: float = 0.035 # front skirt below the painted bumper
    rear_valance_height: float = 0.045  # rear skirt below the bumper
    belt_height: float = 0.95      # door shoulder / belt line height
    belt_rake: float = 0.03        # belt rises this much from front door to rear door
    side_bulge: float = 0.02       # convexity of the door skin
    # ---- front end -----------------------------------------------------------
    front_bumper_bottom: float = 0.30
    hood_front_height: float = 0.76
    cowl_height: float = 0.98      # windshield base
    cowl_offset: float = 0.35      # windshield base is this far behind the front axle
    hood_crown: float = 0.03
    nose_width_ratio: float = 0.72  # flat nose width / body width
    front_corner_length: float = 0.55  # plan-view corner rounding run
    front_fascia_rake: float = 0.03    # upper fascia setback (bumper stays vertical)
    bumper_projection: float = 0.035  # bumper face proud of the end ring
    bumper_crease_height: float = 0.60
    hood_overhang: float = 0.03       # hood lip proud of the upper grille face
    front_splitter: float = 0.025    # lower lip projection beyond the bumper
    rear_bumper_crease_height: float = 0.62
    plate_recess: float = 0.025      # depth of the rear licence-plate pocket
    diffuser_step: float = 0.012     # lower rear valance setback
    tailgate_panel: float = 0.0      # lower tailgate panel setback (two-box bodies)
    # ---- greenhouse ----------------------------------------------------------
    windshield_length: float = 0.90    # horizontal run of the windshield
    roof_height: float = 1.45
    roof_drop: float = 0.02            # roof is lower at the rear
    roof_rear_offset: float = 0.33     # roof ends this far ahead of (+) the rear axle
    rear_window_length: float = 0.70
    roof_crown: float = 0.035
    roof_width_ratio: float = 0.68     # roof rail half width / body half width
    shoulder_inset: float = 0.06       # glass base sits inboard of the belt line
    shoulder_rise: float = 0.03
    shoulder_radius: float = 0.025    # definite rolled shoulder, not a spline bulge
    fender_crease: float = 0.012       # hood skin below fender top
    a_pillar_lean: float = 0.98        # fraction of windshield run (1 = parallel to glass)
    a_pillar_width: float = 0.070      # longitudinal pillar band at the cowl
    glass_recess: float = 0.008        # inward normal offset below the frame
    roof_edge_radius: float = 0.025   # rolled roof-side edge
    drip_rail: float = 0.004          # bead proud of the rolled roof edge
    c_pillar_lean: float = 0.35        # as fraction of rear_window_length
    front_door_length: float = 1.32    # cowl -> B pillar centre
    b_pillar_width: float = 0.10
    quarter_window_length: float = 0.03
    c_pillar_width: float = 0.08
    # ---- rear end ------------------------------------------------------------
    deck_height: float = 0.98          # rear window base / trunk lid (or bed rail)
    deck_rear_height: float = 0.94     # trunk lid at the rear edge
    rear_bumper_bottom: float = 0.32
    tail_width_ratio: float = 0.78
    rear_corner_length: float = 0.45
    rear_fascia_rake: float = 0.02     # >0: tail top protrudes over the bumper
    deck_crown: float = 0.02
    bed_depth: float = 0.0             # >0 turns the deck into an open pickup bed
    # ---- non-geometric hints (do not affect topology) -------------------------
    door_count: int = 4

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "BodyParams":
        valid = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
        unknown = set(d) - valid
        if unknown:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown body parameter(s): {sorted(unknown)}")
        return cls(**d)

    @classmethod
    def numeric_fields(cls):
        return [f.name for f in fields(cls) if f.type in ("float", float)]

    # derived layout -----------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def length(self) -> float:
        return self.wheelbase + self.front_overhang + self.rear_overhang

    @property
    def arch_radius(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2 + self.arch_gap

    @property
    def axle_height(self) -> float:
        return self.wheel_diameter / 2

    def layout(self) -> dict:
        """Key longitudinal positions.  Greenhouse breakpoints are forced to be
        strictly ordered (min gap 2 cm) so the loft topology is always valid."""
        x_fa = self.wheelbase / 2
        x_ra = -self.wheelbase / 2
        x_front = x_fa + self.front_overhang
        x_rear = x_ra - self.rear_overhang
        gap = 0.02
        # ---- upper (greenhouse) chain, front to back ----
        x_cowl = x_fa - self.cowl_offset
        x_roof_front = x_cowl - self.windshield_length
        x_bp = x_cowl - self.front_door_length
        x_bp_f = x_bp + self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_bp_r = x_bp - self.b_pillar_width / 2
        x_roof_rear = x_ra + self.roof_rear_offset
        x_cp_r = x_roof_rear + self.quarter_window_length
        x_cp_f = x_cp_r + self.c_pillar_width
        x_deck = x_roof_rear - self.rear_window_length
        upper = [x_rear, x_deck, x_roof_rear, x_cp_r, x_cp_f, x_bp_r, x_bp_f, x_roof_front, x_cowl, x_front]
        # enforce ordering front->back (front fixed): push items rearward if needed
        for k in range(len(upper) - 2, 0, -1):
            upper[k] = min(upper[k], upper[k + 1] - gap)
        for k in range(1, len(upper) - 1):
            upper[k] = max(upper[k], upper[k - 1] + gap)
        # ---- lower (arch) chain ----
        r = self.arch_radius
        dz = self.sill_height - self.axle_height
        half = math.sqrt(max(r * r - dz * dz, 1e-6)) if dz > 0 else r
        half = min(half, self.wheelbase / 2 - gap, self.front_overhang - 0.1, self.rear_overhang - 0.1)
        lower = [x_rear, x_ra - half, x_ra, x_ra + half, x_fa - half, x_fa, x_fa + half, x_front]
        names_u = ["rear", "deck", "roof_rear", "cp_r", "cp_f", "bp_r", "bp_f", "roof_front", "cowl", "front"]
        names_l = ["rear", "ra_start", "ra", "ra_end", "fa_start", "fa", "fa_end", "front"]
        d = {f"u_{n}": v for n, v in zip(names_u, upper)}
        d.update({f"l_{n}": v for n, v in zip(names_l, lower)})
        d.update(dict(x_front=x_front, x_rear=x_rear, x_fa=x_fa, x_ra=x_ra, arch_half=half, arch_radius=r))
        d["upper"] = upper
        d["lower"] = lower
        return d
